name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.variable_row_nested
statement:
theorem variable_row_nested (h i : Nat) (s : Bool) (p p' a a' : Nat)
    (hp : p ≤ p') (c : Position) (hc : Nonanchor c)
    (he : entry h (.variable i s p' a') c = true) :
    entry h (.variable i s p a) c = true
proof:
:= by
  cases c with
  | anchor => contradiction
  | dummy => rfl
  | «variable» j t q b => cases s <;> cases t <;> simp_all [entry, signed] <;> omega

    entry h r (.variable j t q' b') = true
proof:
:= by

  | anchor => contradiction
  | dummy => rfl
  | «variable» i s p a => cases s <;> cases t <;> simp_all [entry, signed] <;> omega

theorem equal_parity_row_anchor_signature (h i : Nat) (s : Bool)

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.ancestor_sub_one
statement:
private theorem ancestor_sub_one (i j p : Nat) (he : i + 1 = j) :
    ancestor (j - i) p = p / 2
proof:
:= by
  have hs : j - i = 1 := by omega
  rw [hs]
  rfl

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.unpinned_minus
statement:
private theorem unpinned_minus (h l k l0 k0 g0 c i p a d q z j b w : Nat)
    (s u t : Bool) (hl : 1 ≤ l) (hlh : l ≤ h) (hk : k < 6)
    (hl0 : 1 ≤ l0) (hk0 : k0 < 6) (hg0 : g0 < 2)
    (vi : i ≤ h ∧ (i = h → s = true))
    (vd : d ≤ h ∧ (d = h → u = true))
    (vj : j ≤ h ∧ (j = h → t = true))
    (rr : rowRole h l k 0 (.variable i s p a))
    (cc : columnRole h l k 1 (.variable j t b w))
    (hdiff : d ≠ j ∨ u ≠ t)
    (co : TraversalOrdered true (.variable d u q z) (.variable j t b w))
    (hone : entry h (.variable i s p a) (.variable d u q z) = true)
    (hzero : entry h (.variable i s p a) (.variable j t b w) = false)
    (horder : anchorRank (l0 - 1) k0 g0 < anchorRank (l - 1) k 1)
    (hinc : columnRole h l0 k0 g0 (.variable d u q z))
    (hcase : k = 4 ∨ k = 5) :
    i = h ∧ s = true ∧ j = h - 1 ∧ t = false ∧ b = p / 2
proof:
:= by
  rcases hcase with rfl | rfl <;> cases s <;> cases u <;> cases t
  all_goals simp [rowRole, columnRole, signed, entry, TraversalOrdered, anchorRank]
    at rr cc vi vd vj hdiff co hone hzero horder
  all_goals try simp (disch := omega) only [ancestor_sub_one] at co
  all_goals try simp only [ancestor] at co
  all_goals try simp
  all_goals try omega
  all_goals first
    | have heven : q % 2 = 0 := earlier_minus_role_even h d l0 k0 g0 q z
        (by omega) (by omega) hl0 (by unfold anchorRank; omega) hinc
      have hpq : p < q := by omega
      have hqb : q / 2 ≤ b := by omega
      have hbp : b ≤ p / 2 := by omega
      have hsib := OrderedMatrixRemoval4.nonterminal_siblings p q b hpq hqb hbp
      omega
    | rcases hone with hown | hparent
      · have hdiv : p / 2 ≤ q / 2 := Nat.div_le_div_right hown.2
        try simp (disch := omega) only [ancestor_sub_one] at co
        omega
      · omega

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.unpinned_body_localizes
statement:
theorem unpinned_body_localizes (h l k l0 k0 g0 c i p a d q z j b w : Nat)
    (s u t : Bool) (hl : 1 ≤ l) (hlh : l ≤ h) (hk : k < 6)
    (hl0 : 1 ≤ l0) (hk0 : k0 < 6) (hg0 : g0 < 2)
    (vi : i ≤ h ∧ (i = h → s = true))
    (vd : d ≤ h ∧ (d = h → u = true))
    (vj : j ≤ h ∧ (j = h → t = true))
    (rr : rowRole h l k 0 (.variable i s p a))
    (cc : columnRole h l k 1 (.variable j t b w))
    (hdiff : d ≠ j ∨ u ≠ t)
    (co : TraversalOrdered true (.variable d u q z) (.variable j t b w))
    (hone : entry h (.variable i s p a) (.variable d u q z) = true)
    (hzero : entry h (.variable i s p a) (.variable j t b w) = false)
    (horder : anchorRank (l0 - 1) k0 g0 < anchorRank (l - 1) k 1)
    (hinc : columnRole h l0 k0 g0 (.variable d u q z)) :
    i = h ∧ s = true ∧ j = h - 1 ∧ t = false ∧ b = p / 2
proof:
:= by
  have hks : k = 0 ∨ k = 1 ∨ k = 2 ∨ k = 3 ∨ k = 4 ∨ k = 5 := by omega
  rcases hks with hk0' | hk1' | hk2' | hk3' | hk4' | hk5'
  · exact unpinned_vertical_body_localizes h l k l0 k0 g0 c i p a d q z j b w s u t hl hlh hk hl0 hk0 hg0 vi vd vj rr cc hdiff co hone hzero horder hinc (Or.inl hk0')
  · exact unpinned_vertical_body_localizes h l k l0 k0 g0 c i p a d q z j b w s u t hl hlh hk hl0 hk0 hg0 vi vd vj rr cc hdiff co hone hzero horder hinc (Or.inr hk1')
  · exact unpinned_positive_body_localizes h l k l0 k0 g0 c i p a d q z j b w s u t hl hlh hk hl0 hk0 hg0 vi vd vj rr cc hdiff co hone hzero horder hinc (Or.inl hk2')
  · exact unpinned_positive_body_localizes h l k l0 k0 g0 c i p a d q z j b w s u t hl hlh hk hl0 hk0 hg0 vi vd vj rr cc hdiff co hone hzero horder hinc (Or.inr hk3')
  · exact unpinned_minus h l k l0 k0 g0 c i p a d q z j b w s u t hl hlh hk hl0 hk0 hg0 vi vd vj rr cc hdiff co hone hzero horder hinc (Or.inl hk4')
  · exact unpinned_minus h l k l0 k0 g0 c i p a d q z j b w s u t hl hlh hk hl0 hk0 hg0 vi vd vj rr cc hdiff co hone hzero horder hinc (Or.inr hk5')

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.ancestor_add
statement: theorem ancestor_add (a b p : Nat) : ancestor a (ancestor b p) = ancestor (a + b) p
proof:
:= by
  induction a with
  | zero => simp [ancestor]
  | succ a ih => simpa only [ancestor, Nat.succ_add] using congrArg (fun n => n / 2) ih

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.lt_of_ancestor_lt
statement: theorem lt_of_ancestor_lt (d p q : Nat) (he : ancestor d p < ancestor d q) : p < q
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hp : p < q
  · exact hp
  · have hm := ancestor_mono d q p (by omega)
    omega

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.separated_ancestors
statement:
theorem separated_ancestors (base i j p q l r : Nat)
    (hi : base ≤ i) (hj : base ≤ j) (hlr : l < r)
    (hp : ancestor (i - base) p = l) (hq : ancestor (j - base) q = r) :
    (i ≤ j → p < ancestor (j - i) q) ∧
    (j ≤ i → ancestor (i - j) p < q)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hij
    apply lt_of_ancestor_lt (i - base)
    rw [hp, ancestor_add]
    have he : (i - base) + (j - i) = j - base := by omega
    rw [he, hq]
    exact hlr
  · intro hji
    apply lt_of_ancestor_lt (j - base)
    rw [ancestor_add, hq]
    have he : (j - base) + (i - j) = i - base := by omega
    rw [he, hp]
    exact hlr

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.block_traversal_ordered
statement:
private theorem block_traversal_ordered (column : Bool) (depth node size : Nat) (s : Bool) :
    (block depth s node size).Pairwise (TraversalOrdered column)
proof:
:= by
  apply List.pairwise_iff_getElem.mpr
  intro i j hi hj hij
  simp only [block, List.getElem_map, List.getElem_range, TraversalOrdered]
  constructor
  · intro he; exact ⟨Nat.le_refl node, by intro hbad; exact False.elim (hbad.1 hbad.2)⟩
  · constructor <;> intro hbad <;> omega

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.opening_traversal_ordered
statement:
private theorem opening_traversal_ordered (column : Bool) (rem depth node child size : Nat)
    (x y : Position) (hx : x ∈ block depth column node size)
    (hy : y ∈ tree column rem (depth + 1) child) (hchild : child / 2 = node) :
    TraversalOrdered column x y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [block, List.mem_map] at hx
  rcases hx with ⟨a, _, rfl⟩
  have hv := tree_variable column rem (depth + 1) child y hy
  cases y with
  | anchor => contradiction
  | dummy => contradiction
  | «variable» j t q b =>
    have ht := tree_location column rem (depth + 1) child j t q b hy
    have hd : j - depth = (j - (depth + 1)) + 1 := by omega
    have hn : ancestor (j - depth) q = node := by rw [hd, ancestor, ht.2, hchild]
    simp only [TraversalOrdered]
    constructor
    · intro he; omega
    · constructor
      · intro he; rw [hn]; exact ⟨Nat.le_refl node, by intro hn; contradiction⟩
      · intro he; omega

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.closing_traversal_ordered
statement:
private theorem closing_traversal_ordered (column : Bool) (rem depth node child size : Nat)
    (x y : Position) (hx : x ∈ tree column rem (depth + 1) child)
    (hy : y ∈ block depth (!column) node size) (hchild : child / 2 = node) :
    TraversalOrdered column x y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [block, List.mem_map] at hy
  rcases hy with ⟨b, _, rfl⟩
  have hv := tree_variable column rem (depth + 1) child x hx
  cases x with
  | anchor => contradiction
  | dummy => contradiction
  | «variable» i s p a =>
    have ht := tree_location column rem (depth + 1) child i s p a hx
    have hd : i - depth = (i - (depth + 1)) + 1 := by omega
    have hn : ancestor (i - depth) p = node := by rw [hd, ancestor, ht.2, hchild]
    simp only [TraversalOrdered]
    constructor
    · intro he; omega
    · constructor
      · intro he; omega
      · intro he
        rw [hn]
        refine ⟨Nat.le_refl node, ?_⟩
        intro hbad
        cases column <;> simp at hbad

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.siblings_traversal_ordered
statement:
private theorem siblings_traversal_ordered (column : Bool) (rem depth node : Nat)
    (x y : Position)
    (hx : x ∈ tree column rem (depth + 1) (2 * node))
    (hy : y ∈ tree column rem (depth + 1) (2 * node + 1)) : TraversalOrdered column x y
proof:
:= by
  have hvx := tree_variable column rem (depth + 1) (2 * node) x hx
  have hvy := tree_variable column rem (depth + 1) (2 * node + 1) y hy
  cases x with
  | anchor => contradiction
  | dummy => contradiction
  | «variable» i s p a =>
    cases y with
    | anchor => contradiction
    | dummy => contradiction
    | «variable» j t q b =>
      have h0 := tree_location column rem (depth + 1) (2 * node) i s p a hx
      have h1 := tree_location column rem (depth + 1) (2 * node + 1) j t q b hy
      have hs := separated_ancestors (depth + 1) i j p q (2 * node) (2 * node + 1)
        h0.1 h1.1 (by omega) h0.2 h1.2
      simp only [TraversalOrdered]
      constructor
      · intro he
        have hl := hs.1 (by omega)
        have hpq : p < q := by simpa [he, ancestor] using hl
        exact ⟨Nat.le_of_lt hpq, fun _ => hpq⟩
      · constructor
        · intro hij; have hl := hs.1 (by omega); exact ⟨Nat.le_of_lt hl, fun _ => hl⟩
        · intro hji; have hl := hs.2 (by omega); exact ⟨Nat.le_of_lt hl, fun _ => hl⟩

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.tree_traversal_ordered
statement:
theorem tree_traversal_ordered (column : Bool) (rem depth node : Nat) :
    (tree column rem depth node).Pairwise (TraversalOrdered column)
proof:
:= by
  induction rem generalizing depth node with
  | zero => simp [tree]
  | succ rem ih =>
    have hab : (block depth column node (2 ^ (rem + 1)) ++
        tree column rem (depth + 1) (2 * node)).Pairwise (TraversalOrdered column) := by
      apply List.pairwise_append.mpr
      refine ⟨block_traversal_ordered .., ih .., ?_⟩
      intro x hx y hy
      exact opening_traversal_ordered column rem depth node _ _ x y hx hy (by omega)
    have habc : ((block depth column node (2 ^ (rem + 1)) ++
        tree column rem (depth + 1) (2 * node)) ++
        tree column rem (depth + 1) (2 * node + 1)).Pairwise (TraversalOrdered column) := by
      apply List.pairwise_append.mpr
      refine ⟨hab, ih .., ?_⟩
      intro x hx y hy
      rcases List.mem_append.mp hx with hx | hx
      · exact opening_traversal_ordered column rem depth node _ _ x y hx hy (by omega)
      · exact siblings_traversal_ordered column rem depth node x y hx hy
    unfold tree
    apply List.pairwise_append.mpr
    refine ⟨habc, block_traversal_ordered .., ?_⟩
    intro x hx y hy
    rcases List.mem_append.mp hx with hx | hx
    · rcases List.mem_append.mp hx with hx | hx
      · simp only [block, List.mem_map] at hx hy
        rcases hx with ⟨a, _, rfl⟩
        rcases hy with ⟨b, _, rfl⟩
        simp only [TraversalOrdered]
        constructor
        · intro he
          refine ⟨Nat.le_refl node, ?_⟩
          intro hbad
          exact False.elim (hbad.1 rfl)
        · constructor <;> intro hbad <;> omega
      · exact closing_traversal_ordered column rem depth node _ _ x y hx hy (by omega)
    · exact closing_traversal_ordered column rem depth node _ _ x y hx hy (by omega)

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.axis_traversal_ordered
statement:
theorem axis_traversal_ordered (column : Bool) (h : Nat) :
    (axis column h).Pairwise (TraversalOrdered column)
proof:
:= by
  have ha : (anchors h).Pairwise (TraversalOrdered column) := by
    apply List.pairwise_iff_getElem.mpr
    intro i j hi hj hij
    simp only [anchors, List.getElem_map, List.getElem_range, anchorLabel, TraversalOrdered]
  have hd : (dummies h).Pairwise (TraversalOrdered column) := by
    apply List.pairwise_iff_getElem.mpr
    intro i j hi hj hij
    simp only [dummies, List.getElem_map, List.getElem_range, TraversalOrdered]
  have hn : (nonanchors column h).Pairwise (TraversalOrdered column) := by
    cases column <;> unfold nonanchors <;> simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte]
    · apply List.pairwise_append.mpr
      refine ⟨tree_traversal_ordered .., hd, ?_⟩
      intro x hx y hy
      simp only [dummies, List.mem_map] at hy
      rcases hy with ⟨a, _, rfl⟩
      cases x <;> trivial
    · apply List.pairwise_append.mpr
      refine ⟨hd, tree_traversal_ordered .., ?_⟩
      intro x hx y hy
      simp only [dummies, List.mem_map] at hx
      rcases hx with ⟨a, _, rfl⟩
      cases y <;> trivial
  apply List.pairwise_append.mpr
  refine ⟨ha, hn, ?_⟩
  intro x hx y hy
  simp only [anchors, List.mem_map] at hx
  rcases hx with ⟨index, _, rfl⟩
  unfold anchorLabel
  cases y <;> trivial

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.indexed_traversal_ordered
statement:
theorem indexed_traversal_ordered (column : Bool) (h : Nat) (x y : Fin (size h))
    (hxy : x.val < y.val) : TraversalOrdered column (labelAt column h x) (labelAt column h y)
proof:
:= by
  have hxlen : x.val < (axis column h).length := by rw [axis_length]; exact x.isLt
  have hylen : y.val < (axis column h).length := by rw [axis_length]; exact y.isLt
  exact (axis_traversal_ordered column h).rel_getElem_of_lt hxlen hylen hxy

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.same_class_node_order
statement:
theorem same_class_node_order (column : Bool) (h i p q a b : Nat) (s : Bool)
    (x y : Fin (size h)) (hxy : x.val < y.val)
    (hx : labelAt column h x = .variable i s p a)
    (hy : labelAt column h y = .variable i s q b) : p ≤ q
proof:
:= by
  have ht := indexed_traversal_ordered column h x y hxy
  rw [hx, hy] at ht
  exact (ht.1 rfl).1

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.child_before_parent_bound
statement:
theorem child_before_parent_bound (column : Bool) (h i p q a b : Nat) (s t : Bool)
    (x y : Fin (size h)) (hxy : x.val < y.val)
    (hx : labelAt column h x = .variable (i + 1) s p a)
    (hy : labelAt column h y = .variable i t q b) :
    p / 2 ≤ q ∧ (t = column → p / 2 < q)
proof:
:= by
  have ht := indexed_traversal_ordered column h x y hxy
  rw [hx, hy] at ht
  have hb := ht.2.2 (Nat.lt_succ_self i)
  simpa [ancestor] using hb

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.parent_before_child_bound
statement:
theorem parent_before_child_bound (column : Bool) (h i p q a b : Nat) (s t : Bool)
    (x y : Fin (size h)) (hxy : x.val < y.val)
    (hx : labelAt column h x = .variable i s p a)
    (hy : labelAt column h y = .variable (i + 1) t q b) :
    p ≤ q / 2 ∧ (s ≠ column → p < q / 2)
proof:
:= by
  have ht := indexed_traversal_ordered column h x y hxy
  rw [hx, hy] at ht
  have hb := ht.2.1 (Nat.lt_succ_self i)
  simpa [ancestor] using hb

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.same_level_phase_order
statement:
theorem same_level_phase_order (column : Bool) (h i p q a b : Nat) (s t : Bool)
    (x y : Fin (size h)) (hxy : x.val < y.val)
    (hx : labelAt column h x = .variable i s p a)
    (hy : labelAt column h y = .variable i t q b) :
    p ≤ q ∧ (s ≠ column ∧ t = column → p < q)
proof:
:= by
  have ht := indexed_traversal_ordered column h x y hxy
  rw [hx, hy] at ht
  exact ht.1 rfl

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.count_le_of_witness
statement:
theorem count_le_of_witness {α β : Type} (xs : List α) (ys : List β)
    (hx : xs.Nodup) (f : α → β) (hf : ∀ a ∈ xs, f a ∈ ys)
    (hinj : ∀ a ∈ xs, ∀ b ∈ xs, f a = f b → a = b) : xs.length ≤ ys.length
proof:
:= by
  have hm : (xs.map f).Nodup := by
    rw [List.nodup_iff_pairwise_ne,List.pairwise_map]
    apply hx.imp_of_mem
    intro a b ha hb hab he
    exact hab (hinj a ha b hb he)
  have hs : xs.map f ⊆ ys := by
    intro y hy
    rcases List.mem_map.mp hy with ⟨a,ha,rfl⟩
    exact hf a ha
  simpa using hm.length_le_of_subset hs

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.mem_edits
statement:
theorem mem_edits (h : Nat) (B : BinaryMatrix (size h)) (r c : Fin (size h)) :
    (r,c) ∈ edits h B ↔ B r c ≠ matrix h r c
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [edits,mem_cartesian,List.mem_finRange]

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.edits_nodup
statement: theorem edits_nodup (h : Nat) (B : BinaryMatrix (size h)) : (edits h B).Nodup
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact List.Pairwise.filter _ (cartesian_nodup _ _ (List.nodup_finRange _) (List.nodup_finRange _))

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.edit_count_of_separating_paths
statement:
theorem edit_count_of_separating_paths (h : Nat) (hh : 1 ≤ h)
    (B : BinaryMatrix (size h)) (hf : HFree H4 B)
    {α : Type} (samples : List α) (hn : samples.Nodup) (paths : α → PathSelection h)
    (hsep : ∀ a ∈ samples, ∀ b ∈ samples, ∀ r c,
      (paths a).Selected false r → (paths a).Selected true c →
      (paths b).Selected false r → (paths b).Selected true c →
      Protected h r c → a = b) : samples.length ≤ editCount h B
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hex : ∀ a ∈ samples, ∃ cell : Fin (size h) × Fin (size h),
      cell ∈ edits h B ∧ (paths a).Selected false cell.1 ∧
      (paths a).Selected true cell.2 ∧ Protected h cell.1 cell.2 := by
    intro a ha
    apply Classical.byContradiction
    intro hbad
    have hint : IntactPath h B (paths a) := by
      intro r c hr hc hp
      apply Classical.byContradiction
      intro he
      exact hbad ⟨(r,c),(mem_edits h B r c).mpr he,hr,hc,hp⟩
    rcases intact_path_contains_copy h hh B (paths a) hint with ⟨rows,cols,hcopy⟩
    exact hf rows cols hcopy
  let witness : α → Fin (size h) × Fin (size h) := fun a =>
    if ha : a ∈ samples then Classical.choose (hex a ha) else
      (⟨0,by unfold size; exact Nat.mul_pos (by omega) (Nat.pow_pos (by decide : 0 < 2))⟩,
       ⟨0,by unfold size; exact Nat.mul_pos (by omega) (Nat.pow_pos (by decide : 0 < 2))⟩)
  have hw : ∀ a (ha : a ∈ samples),
      witness a ∈ edits h B ∧ (paths a).Selected false (witness a).1 ∧
      (paths a).Selected true (witness a).2 ∧ Protected h (witness a).1 (witness a).2 := by
    intro a ha
    simpa only [witness,dif_pos ha] using Classical.choose_spec (hex a ha)
  apply count_le_of_witness samples (edits h B) hn witness
  · intro a ha; exact (hw a ha).1
  · intro a ha b hb he
    have hb' := hw b hb
    rw [← he] at hb'
    exact hsep a ha b hb (witness a).1 (witness a).2 (hw a ha).2.1 (hw a ha).2.2.1
      hb'.2.1 hb'.2.2.1 (hw a ha).2.2.2

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.unpinned_vertical_body_localizes
statement:
theorem unpinned_vertical_body_localizes (h l k l0 k0 g0 c i p a d q z j b w : Nat)
    (s u t : Bool) (hl : 1 ≤ l) (hlh : l ≤ h) (hk : k < 6)
    (hl0 : 1 ≤ l0) (hk0 : k0 < 6) (hg0 : g0 < 2)
    (vi : i ≤ h ∧ (i = h → s = true))
    (vd : d ≤ h ∧ (d = h → u = true))
    (vj : j ≤ h ∧ (j = h → t = true))
    (rr : rowRole h l k 0 (.variable i s p a))
    (cc : columnRole h l k 1 (.variable j t b w))
    (hdiff : d ≠ j ∨ u ≠ t)
    (co : TraversalOrdered true (.variable d u q z) (.variable j t b w))
    (hone : entry h (.variable i s p a) (.variable d u q z) = true)
    (hzero : entry h (.variable i s p a) (.variable j t b w) = false)
    (horder : anchorRank (l0 - 1) k0 g0 < anchorRank (l - 1) k 1)
    (hinc : columnRole h l0 k0 g0 (.variable d u q z))
    (hcase : k = 0 ∨ k = 1) :
    i = h ∧ s = true ∧ j = h - 1 ∧ t = false ∧ b = p / 2
proof:
:= by
  rcases hcase with rfl | rfl <;> cases s <;> cases u <;> cases t
  all_goals simp [rowRole, columnRole, signed, entry, TraversalOrdered, anchorRank]
    at rr cc vi vd vj hdiff co hone hzero horder
  all_goals try simp (disch := omega) only [ancestor_sub_one] at co
  all_goals try simp only [ancestor] at co
  all_goals first
    | omega
    | have heven : q % 2 = 0 := earlier_minus_role_even h d l0 k0 g0 q z
        (by omega) (by omega) hl0 (by unfold anchorRank; omega) hinc
      omega

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.unpinned_positive_body_localizes
statement:
theorem unpinned_positive_body_localizes (h l k l0 k0 g0 c i p a d q z j b w : Nat)
    (s u t : Bool) (hl : 1 ≤ l) (hlh : l ≤ h) (hk : k < 6)

    (hcase : k = 2 ∨ k = 3) :

proof:

  rcases hcase with rfl | rfl <;> cases s <;> cases u <;> cases t
  all_goals simp [rowRole, columnRole, signed, entry, TraversalOrdered, anchorRank]

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.TerminalAnchorRepair.changed_iff_tags
statement:
theorem changed_iff_tags (h : Nat) (r c : Fin (size h)) :
    matrix h r c ≠ Host.matrix h r c ↔
    ∃ p a, labelAt false h r = .variable h true p 0 ∧
      labelAt true h c = .anchor h (4+p%2) 0 a
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro he
    have hp : TerminalColumn h (labelAt true h c) ∧ Nonanchor (labelAt false h r) := by
      by_cases hn : TerminalColumn h (labelAt true h c) ∧ Nonanchor (labelAt false h r)
      · exact hn
      · simp [matrix,hn] at he
    have hz := terminal_nonanchor_zero h r c hp.2 hp.1
    have ho : Host.matrix h r c = true := by
      cases hh : Host.matrix h r c <;> simp_all
    cases hc : labelAt true h c with
    | «variable» => simp [hc,TerminalColumn] at hp
    | dummy => simp [hc,TerminalColumn] at hp
    | anchor l k g a =>
      have ht : l=h ∧ (k=4 ∨ k=5) ∧ g=0 := by simpa [hc,TerminalColumn] using hp.1
      rcases ht with ⟨hl,hk,hg⟩
      subst l
      subst g
      cases hr : labelAt false h r with
      | anchor => simp [hr,Nonanchor] at hp
      | dummy =>
        rcases hk with rfl | rfl <;> simp [Host.matrix,hr,hc,entry,rowRole] at ho
      | «variable» j s p b =>
        have hm : j=h ∧ p%2=k-4 := by
          rcases hk with rfl | rfl <;> cases s <;>
            simp [Host.matrix,hr,hc,entry,rowRole,signed] at ho <;> omega
        rcases hm with ⟨hj,hmod⟩
        subst j
        have hv := labelAt_valid false h r
        have hs : s=true := by simpa [hr,Valid] using hv
        subst s
        have hb := leaf_tag_clone_zero false h true p b
          (hr ▸ List.getElem_mem (labelAt._proof_1 false h r))
        subst b
        have heq : k=4+p%2 := by rcases hk with hk | hk <;> omega
        exact ⟨p,a,rfl,by simp [heq]⟩
  · rintro ⟨p,a,hr,hc⟩
    have hp : p%2=0 ∨ p%2=1 := by omega
    have hz : matrix h r c = false := by
      rcases hp with hp | hp <;> simp [matrix,hr,hc,TerminalColumn,Nonanchor,hp]
    have ho : Host.matrix h r c = true := by
      rcases hp with hp | hp <;> simp [Host.matrix,hr,hc,entry,rowRole,signed,hp]
    rw [hz,ho]
    decide

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.TerminalAnchorRepair.anchor_clone_bound
statement:
theorem anchor_clone_bound (h : Nat) (c : Fin (size h)) (l k g a : Nat)
    (hc : labelAt true h c = .anchor l k g a) : a < 2^h
proof:
:= by
  have hj := anchor_index_lt true h c l k g a hc
  have he := hc
  rw [labelAt_append,List.getElem_append_left hj] at he
  simp only [anchors,List.getElem_map,List.getElem_range,anchorLabel] at he
  have hea : c.val%2^h=a := (Position.anchor.inj he).2.2.2
  rw [← hea]
  exact Nat.mod_lt _ (Nat.pow_pos (by decide))

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.TerminalAnchorRepair.cell_tag_members
statement:
theorem cell_tag_members (h : Nat) (hh : 1 ≤ h) (p a : Fin (2^h)) :
    .variable h true p.val 0 ∈ axis false h ∧
    .anchor h (4+p.val%2) 0 a.val ∈ axis true h
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rw [variable_axis_mem_iff]
    exact ⟨by omega,p.isLt,by simp,by simp⟩
  · exact anchor_tag_mem true h h (4+p.val%2) 0 a.val hh (by omega)
      (by omega) (by omega) a.isLt

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.TerminalAnchorRepair.cell_labels
statement:
theorem cell_labels (h : Nat) (hh : 1 ≤ h) (p a : Fin (2^h)) :
    labelAt false h (cell h p a).1 = .variable h true p.val 0 ∧
    labelAt true h (cell h p a).2 = .anchor h (4+p.val%2) 0 a.val
proof:
:=
  ⟨pick_label false h _ (cell_tag_members h hh p a).1,
   pick_label true h _ (cell_tag_members h hh p a).2⟩

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.TerminalAnchorRepair.candidates_length
statement: theorem candidates_length (h : Nat) : (candidates h).length = (2^h)^2
proof:
:= by
  simp [candidates,cartesian_length,Nat.pow_succ]

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.TerminalAnchorRepair.edits_subset
statement: theorem edits_subset (h : Nat) (hh : 1 ≤ h) : Host.edits h (matrix h) ⊆ candidates h
proof:
:= by
  intro e he
  rcases e with ⟨r,c⟩
  have hd := (Host.mem_edits h (matrix h) r c).mp he
  rcases (changed_iff_tags h r c).mp hd with ⟨p,a,hr,hc⟩
  have hp := (variable_axis_mem_iff false h h true p 0).mp
    (hr ▸ List.getElem_mem (labelAt._proof_1 false h r))
  have ha := anchor_clone_bound h c h (4+p%2) 0 a hc
  let pp : Fin (2^h) := ⟨p,hp.2.1⟩
  let aa : Fin (2^h) := ⟨a,ha⟩
  have hl := cell_labels h hh pp aa
  have heq : cell h pp aa = (r,c) := Prod.ext
    (labelAt_injective false h _ _ (hl.1.trans hr.symm))
    (labelAt_injective true h _ _ (hl.2.trans hc.symm))
  exact List.mem_map.mpr ⟨(pp,aa),(mem_cartesian _ _ _ _).mpr
    ⟨List.mem_finRange _,List.mem_finRange _⟩,heq⟩

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.TerminalAnchorRepair.edit_count
statement: theorem edit_count (h : Nat) (hh : 1 ≤ h) : Host.editCount h (matrix h) = (2^h)^2
proof:
:= by
  apply Nat.le_antisymm
  · have he := (Host.edits_nodup h (matrix h)).length_le_of_subset (edits_subset h hh)
    simpa [Host.editCount,candidates_length] using he
  · exact arbitrary_edit_distance h hh (matrix h) (free h hh)

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.TerminalAnchorRepair.exact_minimum
statement:
theorem exact_minimum (h : Nat) (hh : 1 ≤ h) :
    HFree H4 (matrix h) ∧ Host.editCount h (matrix h) = (2^h)^2 ∧
    ∀ B : BinaryMatrix (size h), HFree H4 B → (2^h)^2 ≤ Host.editCount h B
proof:
:=
  ⟨free h hh,edit_count h hh,fun B hf => arbitrary_edit_distance h hh B hf⟩

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.frame_extension
statement:
theorem frame_extension {n : Nat} (B : BinaryMatrix n) (rows cols : Fin 4 → Fin n)
    (hg : FrameGuard B rows cols) (hb : BodyBits B rows cols true false true true) :
    OrderedCopy H4 B rows cols
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨hg.1, hg.2.1, ?_⟩
  intro i j
  by_cases ha : i.val < 2 ∨ j.val < 2
  · exact hg.2.2 i j ha
  · have hi : i = 2 ∨ i = 3 := by omega
    have hj : j = 2 ∨ j = 3 := by omega
    rcases hi with rfl | rfl <;> rcases hj with rfl | rfl
    · exact hb.1
    · exact hb.2.1
    · exact hb.2.2.1
    · exact hb.2.2.2

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.body_forbidden_of_free
statement:
theorem body_forbidden_of_free {n : Nat} (B : BinaryMatrix n)
    (hf : HFree H4 B) (rows cols : Fin 4 → Fin n) (hg : FrameGuard B rows cols) :
    ¬ BodyBits B rows cols true false true true
proof:
:= by
  intro hb
  exact hf rows cols (frame_extension B rows cols hg hb)

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.guarded_path_contradiction
statement:
theorem guarded_path_contradiction {n : Nat} (B : BinaryMatrix n) (h : Nat)
    (hf : HFree H4 B) (dp dm up um : Nat → Bool)
    (vrp vcp vrm vcm wrp wcp wrm wcm : Nat → Fin 4 → Fin n)
    (hp : dp 0 = true) (hm : dm 0 = false) (hleaf : dp h = dm h)
    (hframes : ∀ i, i < h →
      FrameGuard B (vrp i) (vcp i) ∧ FrameGuard B (vrm i) (vcm i) ∧
      FrameGuard B (wrp i) (wcp i) ∧ FrameGuard B (wrm i) (wcm i))
    (hbodies : ∀ i, i < h →
      BodyBits B (vrp i) (vcp i) true (up i) true (dp i) ∧
      BodyBits B (vrm i) (vcm i) true (dm i) true (um i) ∧
      BodyBits B (wrp i) (wcp i) (up i) (dp (i + 1)) true true ∧
      BodyBits B (wrm i) (wcm i) (dm (i + 1)) (um i) true true) : False
proof:
:= by
  have hind : ∀ j, j ≤ h → dp j = true ∧ dm j = false := by
    intro j
    induction j with
    | zero => intro _; exact ⟨hp, hm⟩
    | succ j ih =>
      intro hj
      have hlt : j < h := by omega
      have hd := ih (by omega)
      have hg := hframes j hlt
      have hb := hbodies j hlt
      have hu : up j = true := by
        cases hu' : up j
        · have hbad := hb.1
          rw [hu', hd.1] at hbad
          exact False.elim (body_forbidden_of_free B hf _ _ hg.1 hbad)
        · rfl
      have hv : um j = false := by
        cases hv' : um j
        · rfl
        · have hbad := hb.2.1
          rw [hv', hd.2] at hbad
          exact False.elim (body_forbidden_of_free B hf _ _ hg.2.1 hbad)
      constructor
      · cases hn : dp (j + 1)
        · have hbad := hb.2.2.1
          rw [hu, hn] at hbad
          exact False.elim (body_forbidden_of_free B hf _ _ hg.2.2.1 hbad)
        · rfl
      · cases hn : dm (j + 1)
        · rfl
        · have hbad := hb.2.2.2
          rw [hv, hn] at hbad
          exact False.elim (body_forbidden_of_free B hf _ _ hg.2.2.2 hbad)
  have hend := hind h (Nat.le_refl h)
  rw [hend.1, hend.2] at hleaf
  contradiction

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.sparse_tag_members
statement:
theorem sparse_tag_members (h : Nat) (hh : 1 ≤ h) (p : Fin (2 ^ h)) (b : Fin 2) :
    .variable h true p.val 0 ∈ axis false h ∧
    .variable (h - 1) false (p.val / 2) b.val ∈ axis true h
proof:
:= by
  have he : h = (h - 1) + 1 := by omega
  have hp : p.val / 2 < 2 ^ (h - 1) := by
    apply (Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul (by decide : 0 < 2)).mpr
    have hepow : 2 ^ h = 2 ^ (h - 1) * 2 := by
      calc
        2 ^ h = 2 ^ ((h - 1) + 1) := congrArg (fun e => 2 ^ e) he
        _ = 2 ^ (h - 1) * 2 := Nat.pow_succ ..
    rw [← hepow]
    exact p.isLt
  constructor
  · rw [variable_axis_mem_iff]
    exact ⟨by omega,p.isLt,by simp,by simp⟩
  · rw [variable_axis_mem_iff]
    refine ⟨by omega,hp,?_,?_⟩
    · have hd : h - (h - 1) = 1 := by omega
      simpa only [hd] using b.isLt
    · intro he; omega

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.sparseCell_labels
statement:
theorem sparseCell_labels (h : Nat) (hh : 1 ≤ h) (p : Fin (2 ^ h)) (b : Fin 2) :
    labelAt false h (sparseCell h hh p b).1 = .variable h true p.val 0 ∧
    labelAt true h (sparseCell h hh p b).2 = .variable (h - 1) false (p.val / 2) b.val
proof:
:=
  ⟨Classical.choose_spec (labelAt_surjective false h _ (sparse_tag_members h hh p b).1),
   Classical.choose_spec (labelAt_surjective true h _ (sparse_tag_members h hh p b).2)⟩

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.sparseCell_injective
statement:
theorem sparseCell_injective (h : Nat) (hh : 1 ≤ h) (p q : Fin (2 ^ h)) (a b : Fin 2)
    (he : sparseCell h hh p a = sparseCell h hh q b) : p = q ∧ a = b
proof:
:= by
  have hr := congrArg (fun c => labelAt false h c.1) he
  have hc := congrArg (fun c => labelAt true h c.2) he
  rw [(sparseCell_labels h hh p a).1, (sparseCell_labels h hh q b).1] at hr
  rw [(sparseCell_labels h hh p a).2, (sparseCell_labels h hh q b).2] at hc
  exact ⟨Fin.ext (Position.variable.inj hr).2.2.1,
    Fin.ext (Position.variable.inj hc).2.2.2⟩

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.sparseCells_length
statement:
theorem sparseCells_length (h : Nat) (hh : 1 ≤ h) :
    (sparseCells h hh).length = 2 * 2 ^ h
proof:
:= by
  simp [sparseCells, List.length_flatMap, List.map_const', List.sum_replicate_nat, Nat.mul_comm]

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.sparseCells_nodup
statement: theorem sparseCells_nodup (h : Nat) (hh : 1 ≤ h) : (sparseCells h hh).Nodup
proof:
:= by
  apply List.pairwise_flatMap.mpr
  constructor
  · intro p hp
    exact List.Pairwise.map _ (fun a b hab he => hab (sparseCell_injective h hh p p a b he).2)
      (List.nodup_finRange 2)
  · apply (List.nodup_finRange (2 ^ h)).imp
    intro p q hpq x hx y hy he
    rcases List.mem_map.mp hx with ⟨a,ha,rfl⟩
    rcases List.mem_map.mp hy with ⟨b,hb,rfl⟩
    exact hpq (sparseCell_injective h hh p q a b he).1

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.mem_sparseCells_iff
statement:
theorem mem_sparseCells_iff (h : Nat) (hh : 1 ≤ h) (r c : Fin (size h)) :
    (r,c) ∈ sparseCells h hh ↔ sparseZero h r c
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hm
    rcases List.mem_flatMap.mp hm with ⟨p,hp,hm⟩
    rcases List.mem_map.mp hm with ⟨b,hb,he⟩
    have hl := sparseCell_labels h hh p b
    rw [he] at hl
    exact ⟨p.val,b.val,hl⟩
  · rintro ⟨p,b,hr,hc⟩
    have hpr := (variable_axis_mem_iff false h h true p 0).mp
      (hr ▸ List.getElem_mem (labelAt._proof_1 false h r))
    have hbc := (variable_axis_mem_iff true h (h-1) false (p/2) b).mp
      (hc ▸ List.getElem_mem (labelAt._proof_1 true h c))
    have hd : h - (h - 1) = 1 := by omega
    have hb : b < 2 := by simpa only [hd] using hbc.2.2.1
    let pp : Fin (2 ^ h) := ⟨p,hpr.2.1⟩
    let bb : Fin 2 := ⟨b,hb⟩
    have hl := sparseCell_labels h hh pp bb
    have he : sparseCell h hh pp bb = (r,c) := Prod.ext
      (labelAt_injective false h _ _ (hl.1.trans hr.symm))
      (labelAt_injective true h _ _ (hl.2.trans hc.symm))
    exact List.mem_flatMap.mpr ⟨pp,List.mem_finRange pp,
      List.mem_map.mpr ⟨bb,List.mem_finRange bb,he⟩⟩

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.sparse_zero_is_zero
statement:
theorem sparse_zero_is_zero (h : Nat) (hh : 1 ≤ h) (r c : Fin (size h))
    (hz : sparseZero h r c) : matrix h r c = false
proof:
:= by
  rcases hz with ⟨p,b,hr,hc⟩
  have hd : h ≠ h - 1 := by omega
  simp [matrix,hr,hc,entry,signed,hd]

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.ancestor_mono
statement: theorem ancestor_mono (d p q : Nat) (hpq : p ≤ q) : ancestor d p ≤ ancestor d q
proof:
:= by
  induction d with
  | zero => exact hpq
  | succ d ih => exact Nat.div_le_div_right ih

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.ancestor_div_two
statement: theorem ancestor_div_two (d p : Nat) : ancestor d (p / 2) = ancestor (d + 1) p
proof:
:= by
  induction d with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ d ih => simpa only [ancestor] using congrArg (fun n => n / 2) ih

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.block_data
proof:
:= by
  simp only [block, List.mem_map] at hm
  rcases hm with ⟨b, _, he⟩
  have hd := Position.variable.inj he
  exact ⟨hd.1.symm, hd.2.1.symm, hd.2.2.1.symm⟩

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.opening_ordered
statement:
private theorem opening_ordered (depth node size : Nat) (x y : Position)
    (hm : x ∈ block depth true node size) : MinusParentOrdered x y
proof:
:= by
  intro i q b a z hi hx _
  rw [hx] at hm
  have hf := (block_data depth node size i q a false true hm).2.1
  contradiction

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.closing_ordered
statement:
private theorem closing_ordered (depth node size : Nat) :
    (block depth false node size).Pairwise MinusParentOrdered
proof:
:= by
  apply List.pairwise_iff_getElem.mpr
  intro a b ha hb _ i q p x z hi hx hy
  have hx' := List.getElem_mem ha
  have hy' := List.getElem_mem hb
  rw [hx] at hx'
  rw [hy] at hy'
  have hd0 := (block_data depth node size i q x false false hx').1
  have hd1 := (block_data depth node size (i - 1) p z false false hy').1
  omega

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.siblings_ordered
proof:
:= by
  intro i q b a z hi he0 he1
  rw [he0] at hx
  rw [he1] at hy
  have h0 := tree_location true rem (depth + 1) (2 * node) i false q a hx
  have h1 := tree_location true rem (depth + 1) (2 * node + 1) (i - 1) false b z hy
  have hd : i - (depth + 1) = (i - 1 - (depth + 1)) + 1 := by omega
  have he : ancestor (i - 1 - (depth + 1)) (q / 2) = 2 * node := by
    rw [ancestor_div_two, ← hd]
    exact h0.2
  by_cases hb : q / 2 ≤ b
  · exact hb
  · have hmono := ancestor_mono (i - 1 - (depth + 1)) b (q / 2) (by omega)
    rw [he, h1.2] at hmono
    omega

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.child_closing_ordered
statement:
private theorem child_closing_ordered (rem depth node child size : Nat)
    (hchild : child = 2 * node ∨ child = 2 * node + 1) (x y : Position)
    (hx : x ∈ tree true rem (depth + 1) child)
    (hy : y ∈ block depth false node size) : MinusParentOrdered x y
proof:
:= by
  intro i q b a z hi he0 he1
  rw [he0] at hx
  rw [he1] at hy
  have h0 := tree_location true rem (depth + 1) child i false q a hx
  have h1 := block_data depth node size (i - 1) b z false false hy
  have hd : i = depth + 1 := by omega
  have hq : q = child := by simpa [hd, ancestor] using h0.2
  omega

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.tree_minus_parent_ordered
statement:
theorem tree_minus_parent_ordered (rem depth node : Nat) :
    (tree true rem depth node).Pairwise MinusParentOrdered
proof:
:= by
  induction rem generalizing depth node with
  | zero => simp [tree]
  | succ rem ih =>
    have hop : (block depth true node (2 ^ (rem + 1))).Pairwise MinusParentOrdered := by
      apply List.pairwise_iff_getElem.mpr
      intro i j hi hj hij
      exact opening_ordered depth node _ _ _ (List.getElem_mem hi)
    have hab : (block depth true node (2 ^ (rem + 1)) ++
        tree true rem (depth + 1) (2 * node)).Pairwise MinusParentOrdered := by
      apply List.pairwise_append.mpr
      refine ⟨hop, ih .., ?_⟩
      intro x hx y _
      exact opening_ordered depth node _ x y hx
    have habc : ((block depth true node (2 ^ (rem + 1)) ++
        tree true rem (depth + 1) (2 * node)) ++
        tree true rem (depth + 1) (2 * node + 1)).Pairwise MinusParentOrdered := by
      apply List.pairwise_append.mpr
      refine ⟨hab, ih .., ?_⟩
      intro x hx y hy
      rcases List.mem_append.mp hx with hx | hx
      · exact opening_ordered depth node _ x y hx
      · exact siblings_ordered rem depth node x y hx hy
    unfold tree
    apply List.pairwise_append.mpr
    refine ⟨habc, closing_ordered .., ?_⟩
    intro x hx y hy
    rcases List.mem_append.mp hx with hx | hx
    · rcases List.mem_append.mp hx with hx | hx
      · exact opening_ordered depth node _ x y hx
      · exact child_closing_ordered rem depth node _ _ (Or.inl rfl) x y hx hy
    · exact child_closing_ordered rem depth node _ _ (Or.inr rfl) x y hx hy

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.anchor_ordered_any
statement:
private theorem anchor_ordered_any (h : Nat) (x y : Position) (hx : x ∈ anchors h) :
    MinusParentOrdered x y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [anchors, List.mem_map] at hx
  rcases hx with ⟨index, _, rfl⟩
  intro i q b a z hi he _
  unfold anchorLabel at he
  contradiction

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.dummy_ordered_any
statement:
private theorem dummy_ordered_any (h : Nat) (x y : Position) (hx : x ∈ dummies h) :
    MinusParentOrdered x y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dummies, List.mem_map] at hx
  rcases hx with ⟨index, _, rfl⟩
  intro i q b a z hi he _
  contradiction

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.axis_minus_parent_ordered
statement: theorem axis_minus_parent_ordered (h : Nat) : (axis true h).Pairwise MinusParentOrdered
proof:
:= by
  have ha : (anchors h).Pairwise MinusParentOrdered := by
    apply List.pairwise_iff_getElem.mpr
    intro i j hi hj hij
    exact anchor_ordered_any h _ _ (List.getElem_mem hi)
  have hd : (dummies h).Pairwise MinusParentOrdered := by
    apply List.pairwise_iff_getElem.mpr
    intro i j hi hj hij
    exact dummy_ordered_any h _ _ (List.getElem_mem hi)
  have hn : (dummies h ++ tree true h 0 0).Pairwise MinusParentOrdered := by
    apply List.pairwise_append.mpr
    refine ⟨hd, tree_minus_parent_ordered .., ?_⟩
    intro x hx y _
    exact dummy_ordered_any h x y hx
  apply List.pairwise_append.mpr
  refine ⟨ha, hn, ?_⟩
  intro x hx y _
  exact anchor_ordered_any h x y hx

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.column_minus_child_parent
statement:
theorem column_minus_child_parent (h i q b a z : Nat) (x y : Fin (size h))
    (hi : 1 ≤ i) (hxy : x.val < y.val)
    (hx : labelAt true h x = .variable i false q a)
    (hy : labelAt true h y = .variable (i - 1) false b z) : q / 2 ≤ b
proof:
:= by
  have hxlen : x.val < (axis true h).length := by rw [axis_length]; exact x.isLt
  have hylen : y.val < (axis true h).length := by rw [axis_length]; exact y.isLt
  have hr := (axis_minus_parent_ordered h).rel_getElem_of_lt hxlen hylen hxy
  exact hr i q b a z hi hx hy

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Blowup.project_lift
statement:
theorem project_lift (n t : Nat) (ht : 1 ≤ t) (r : Fin n) (a : Fin t) :
    project n t ht (liftIndex n t ht r a) = r
proof:
:= by
  apply Fin.ext
  dsimp [project,liftIndex]
  rw [Nat.add_comm,Nat.add_mul_div_right _ _ (by omega : 0 < t),Nat.div_eq_of_lt a.isLt]
  simp

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Blowup.lift_clone
statement:
theorem lift_clone (n t : Nat) (ht : 1 ≤ t) (r : Fin n) (a : Fin t) :
    (liftIndex n t ht r a).val % t = a.val
proof:
:= by
  simp [liftIndex,Nat.add_comm,Nat.add_mul_mod_self_right,Nat.mod_eq_of_lt a.isLt]

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Blowup.lift_index_injective
statement:
theorem lift_index_injective (n t : Nat) (ht : 1 ≤ t) (r q : Fin n) (a b : Fin t)
    (he : liftIndex n t ht r a = liftIndex n t ht q b) : r = q ∧ a = b
proof:
:= by
  have hp := congrArg (project n t ht) he
  have hc := congrArg (fun x => x.val%t) he
  rw [project_lift,project_lift] at hp
  rw [lift_clone,lift_clone] at hc
  exact ⟨hp,Fin.ext hc⟩

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Blowup.lift_strict
statement:
theorem lift_strict (n t : Nat) (ht : 1 ≤ t) (r q : Fin n) (a b : Fin t)
    (hrq : r.val < q.val) : (liftIndex n t ht r a).val < (liftIndex n t ht q b).val
proof:
:= by
  have hm := Nat.mul_le_mul_right t (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hrq)
  dsimp [liftIndex]
  rw [Nat.succ_mul] at hm
  omega

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Blowup.slice_copy_lifts
statement:
theorem slice_copy_lifts {n t : Nat} (ht : 1 ≤ t) (B : BinaryMatrix (n*t)) (a b : Fin t)
    (rows cols : Fin 4 → Fin n) (hc : OrderedCopy H4 (slice ht B a b) rows cols) :
    OrderedCopy H4 B (fun i => liftIndex n t ht (rows i) a)
      (fun j => liftIndex n t ht (cols j) b)
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨fun i j hij => lift_strict n t ht _ _ a a (hc.1 i j hij),
    fun i j hij => lift_strict n t ht _ _ b b (hc.2.1 i j hij),hc.2.2⟩

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Blowup.free_slice
statement:
theorem free_slice {n t : Nat} (ht : 1 ≤ t) (B : BinaryMatrix (n*t))
    (hf : HFree H4 B) (a b : Fin t) : HFree H4 (slice ht B a b)
proof:
:= by
  intro rows cols hc
  exact hf _ _ (slice_copy_lifts ht B a b rows cols hc)

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Blowup.mem_edits
statement:
theorem mem_edits {n : Nat} (A B : BinaryMatrix n) (r c : Fin n) :
    (r,c) ∈ edits A B ↔ B r c ≠ A r c
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [edits,mem_cartesian,List.mem_finRange]

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Blowup.edits_nodup
statement: theorem edits_nodup {n : Nat} (A B : BinaryMatrix n) : (edits A B).Nodup
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact List.Pairwise.filter _ (cartesian_nodup _ _ (List.nodup_finRange _) (List.nodup_finRange _))

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Blowup.liftCell_injective
statement:
theorem liftCell_injective (n t : Nat) (ht : 1 ≤ t) (a b c d : Fin t)
    (x y : Fin n × Fin n) (he : liftCell n t ht a b x = liftCell n t ht c d y) :
    a = c ∧ b = d ∧ x = y
proof:
:= by
  have hr := lift_index_injective n t ht x.1 y.1 a c (congrArg Prod.fst he)
  have hc := lift_index_injective n t ht x.2 y.2 b d (congrArg Prod.snd he)
  exact ⟨hr.2,hc.2,Prod.ext hr.1 hc.1⟩

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Blowup.sliceEdits_nodup
statement:
theorem sliceEdits_nodup (h t : Nat) (ht : 1 ≤ t) (B : BinaryMatrix (Host.size h*t)) :
    (sliceEdits h t ht B).Nodup
proof:
:= by
  apply List.pairwise_flatMap.mpr
  constructor
  · intro ab hab
    apply List.Pairwise.map _ _ (Host.edits_nodup h _)
    intro x y hxy he
    exact hxy (liftCell_injective _ _ ht _ _ _ _ x y he).2.2
  · apply (cartesian_nodup _ _ (List.nodup_finRange t) (List.nodup_finRange t)).imp
    intro ab cd hab x hx y hy he
    rcases List.mem_map.mp hx with ⟨e,he',rfl⟩
    rcases List.mem_map.mp hy with ⟨f,hf',rfl⟩
    have hi := liftCell_injective _ _ ht _ _ _ _ e f he
    exact hab (Prod.ext hi.1 hi.2.1)

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Blowup.sliceEdits_subset
statement:
theorem sliceEdits_subset (h t : Nat) (ht : 1 ≤ t) (B : BinaryMatrix (Host.size h*t)) :
    sliceEdits h t ht B ⊆ edits (matrix (Host.matrix h) t ht) B
proof:
:= by
  intro cell hc
  rcases List.mem_flatMap.mp hc with ⟨ab,hab,hc⟩
  rcases List.mem_map.mp hc with ⟨e,he,rfl⟩
  apply (mem_edits _ B _ _).mpr
  have hb := (Host.mem_edits h (slice ht B ab.1 ab.2) e.1 e.2).mp he
  simpa only [matrix,liftCell,project_lift,slice] using hb

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Blowup.length_mul_le_sum_map
statement:
private theorem length_mul_le_sum_map {α : Type} (xs : List α) (f : α → Nat) (k : Nat)
    (hf : ∀ a ∈ xs, k ≤ f a) : xs.length*k ≤ (xs.map f).sum
proof:
:= by
  induction xs with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a xs ih =>
    have ha := hf a (by simp)
    have hb := ih (fun b hb => hf b (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hb))
    simpa only [List.length_cons,List.map_cons,List.sum_cons,Nat.succ_mul,Nat.add_comm] using Nat.add_le_add ha hb

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Blowup.arbitrary_edit_distance
statement:
theorem arbitrary_edit_distance (h t : Nat) (hh : 1 ≤ h) (ht : 1 ≤ t)
    (B : BinaryMatrix (Host.size h*t)) (hf : HFree H4 B) :
    (t*2^h)^2 ≤ editCount (matrix (Host.matrix h) t ht) B
proof:
:= by
  have hsum := length_mul_le_sum_map
    (cartesian (List.finRange t) (List.finRange t))
    (fun ab => Host.editCount h (slice ht B ab.1 ab.2)) ((2^h)^2)
    (fun ab _ => Host.arbitrary_edit_distance h hh _ (free_slice ht B hf ab.1 ab.2))
  have hlen : (t*2^h)^2 ≤ (sliceEdits h t ht B).length := by
    unfold sliceEdits
    simp only [List.length_flatMap,List.length_map]
    have he : (t*2^h)^2 = (t*t)*((2^h)^2) := by
      simp only [Nat.pow_succ,Nat.pow_zero,Nat.one_mul]
      ac_rfl
    rw [he]
    simpa only [cartesian_length,List.length_finRange,Host.editCount] using hsum
  exact Nat.le_trans hlen ((sliceEdits_nodup h t ht B).length_le_of_subset (sliceEdits_subset h t ht B))

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Blowup.project_copy
statement:
theorem project_copy {n : Nat} (A : BinaryMatrix n) (t : Nat) (ht : 1 ≤ t)
    (rows cols : Fin 4 → Fin (n*t)) (hc : OrderedCopy H4 (matrix A t ht) rows cols) :
    OrderedCopy H4 A (fun i => project n t ht (rows i)) (fun j => project n t ht (cols j))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_,?_,hc.2.2⟩
  · intro i j hij
    have hle := Nat.div_le_div_right (c := t) (Nat.le_of_lt (hc.1 i j hij))
    have hne : (project n t ht (rows i)).val ≠ (project n t ht (rows j)).val := by
      intro he
      have hp : project n t ht (rows i) = project n t ht (rows j) := Fin.ext he
      have hij' : i ≠ j := by intro he; subst j; omega
      rcases pattern_rows_distinct i j hij' with ⟨c,hpattern⟩
      have hm1 := hc.2.2 i c
      have hm2 := hc.2.2 j c
      change A (project n t ht (rows i)) (project n t ht (cols c)) = H4 i c at hm1
      change A (project n t ht (rows j)) (project n t ht (cols c)) = H4 j c at hm2
      rw [hp] at hm1
      exact hpattern (hm1.symm.trans hm2)
    change (rows i).val/t < (rows j).val/t
    change (rows i).val/t ≠ (rows j).val/t at hne
    omega
  · intro i j hij
    have hle := Nat.div_le_div_right (c := t) (Nat.le_of_lt (hc.2.1 i j hij))
    have hne : (project n t ht (cols i)).val ≠ (project n t ht (cols j)).val := by
      intro he
      have hp : project n t ht (cols i) = project n t ht (cols j) := Fin.ext he
      have hij' : i ≠ j := by intro he; subst j; omega
      rcases pattern_columns_distinct i j hij' with ⟨r,hpattern⟩
      have hm1 := hc.2.2 r i
      have hm2 := hc.2.2 r j
      change A (project n t ht (rows r)) (project n t ht (cols i)) = H4 r i at hm1
      change A (project n t ht (rows r)) (project n t ht (cols j)) = H4 r j at hm2
      rw [hp] at hm1
      exact hpattern (hm1.symm.trans hm2)
    change (cols i).val/t < (cols j).val/t
    change (cols i).val/t ≠ (cols j).val/t at hne
    omega

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Blowup.lift_project_clone
statement:
theorem lift_project_clone (n t : Nat) (ht : 1 ≤ t) (r : Fin (n*t)) :
    liftIndex n t ht (project n t ht r) (cloneOf n t ht r) = r
proof:
:= by
  apply Fin.ext
  dsimp [liftIndex,project,cloneOf]
  have he := Nat.mod_add_div r.val t
  simpa only [Nat.add_comm,Nat.mul_comm] using he

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Blowup.liftedSparse_length
statement:
theorem liftedSparse_length (h t : Nat) (hh : 1 ≤ h) (ht : 1 ≤ t) :
    (liftedSparse h t hh ht).length = (2*2^h)*(t*t)
proof:
:= by
  simp [liftedSparse,List.length_flatMap,cartesian_length,List.map_const',
    List.sum_replicate_nat,Host.sparseCells_length]

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Blowup.blowup_localization
statement:
theorem blowup_localization (h t : Nat) (hh : 1 ≤ h) (ht : 1 ≤ t)
    (rows cols : Fin 4 → Fin (Host.size h*t))
    (hc : OrderedCopy H4 (matrix (Host.matrix h) t ht) rows cols) :
    (rows 2,cols 3) ∈ liftedSparse h t hh ht
proof:
:= by
  have hproject := project_copy (Host.matrix h) t ht rows cols hc
  have hz := Host.all_copy_localization h hh _ _ hproject
  apply List.mem_flatMap.mpr
  refine ⟨(project (Host.size h) t ht (rows 2),project (Host.size h) t ht (cols 3)),
    (Host.mem_sparseCells_iff h hh _ _).mpr hz,?_⟩
  apply List.mem_map.mpr
  refine ⟨(cloneOf (Host.size h) t ht (rows 2),cloneOf (Host.size h) t ht (cols 3)),
    (mem_cartesian _ _ _ _).mpr ⟨List.mem_finRange _,List.mem_finRange _⟩,?_⟩
  exact Prod.ext (lift_project_clone _ _ ht _) (lift_project_clone _ _ ht _)

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Blowup.copy_count_bound
statement:
theorem copy_count_bound (h t : Nat) (hh : 1 ≤ h) (ht : 1 ≤ t) :
    Counting.copyCount (matrix (Host.matrix h) t ht) ≤
      (2*2^h)*(t*t)*(Host.size h*t)^6
proof:
:= by
  have hb := Counting.bound_from_localization (matrix (Host.matrix h) t ht)
    (liftedSparse h t hh ht) (fun rows cols hc => blowup_localization h t hh ht rows cols hc)
  simpa only [liftedSparse_length] using hb
