name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.selected_guard
statement:
private theorem selected_guard (h i k : Nat) (s : PathSelection h) (hi : i < h) (hk : k < 6)
    (r2 r3 c2 c3 : Fin (size h))
    (rr0 : rowRole h (i+1) k 0 (labelAt false h r2))
    (rr1 : rowRole h (i+1) k 1 (labelAt false h r3))
    (cc0 : columnRole h (i+1) k 0 (labelAt true h c2))
    (cc1 : columnRole h (i+1) k 1 (labelAt true h c3))
    (hro : r2.val < r3.val) (hco : c2.val < c3.val) :
    FrameGuard (matrix h)
      (four (s.ra (i+1) k 0) (s.ra (i+1) k 1) r2 r3)
      (four (s.ca (i+1) k 0) (s.ca (i+1) k 1) c2 c3)
proof:
:=
  canonical_host_guard h (i+1) k _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _
    (s.raLabel _ (by omega) (by omega) _ hk _ (by decide))
    (s.raLabel _ (by omega) (by omega) _ hk _ (by decide))
    (s.caLabel _ (by omega) (by omega) _ hk _ (by decide))
    (s.caLabel _ (by omega) (by omega) _ hk _ (by decide)) rr0 rr1 cc0 cc1 hro hco

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.path_vertical_plus_guard
statement:
theorem path_vertical_plus_guard (h i : Nat) (s : PathSelection h) (hi : i < h) :
    FrameGuard (matrix h)
      (four (s.ra (i+1) 0 0) (s.ra (i+1) 0 1) (s.row (i+1) true) (s.row i true))
      (four (s.ca (i+1) 0 0) (s.ca (i+1) 0 1) s.cd (s.col i true))
proof:
:= by
  have rchild := s.rowLabel (i+1) (by omega) true
  have rparent := s.rowLabel i (by omega) true
  have cparent := s.colLabel i (by omega) true
  simp only [viewSign,ite_self] at rchild rparent cparent
  apply selected_guard h i 0 s hi (by decide)
  · simp [rchild,rowRole,signed]
  · simp [rparent,rowRole,signed]
  · simp [s.cdLabel,columnRole]
  · simp [cparent,columnRole,signed]
  · exact child_before_closing_parent false h i _ _ _ _ true _ _ rchild rparent (s.parent i hi)
  · exact column_dummy_before_variable h i _ _ _ true _ _ s.cdLabel cparent

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.path_vertical_minus_guard
statement:
theorem path_vertical_minus_guard (h i : Nat) (s : PathSelection h) (hi : i < h) :
    FrameGuard (matrix h)
      (four (s.ra (i+1) 1 0) (s.ra (i+1) 1 1) (s.row i false) (s.row (i+1) false))
      (four (s.ca (i+1) 1 0) (s.ca (i+1) 1 1) s.cd (s.col i false))
proof:
:= by
  have rchild := s.rowLabel (i+1) (by omega) false
  have rparent := s.rowLabel i (by omega) false
  have cparent := s.colLabel i (by omega) false
  simp only [viewSign,if_neg (Nat.ne_of_lt hi)] at rparent cparent
  apply selected_guard h i 1 s hi (by decide)
  · simp [rparent,rowRole,signed]
  · simp [rchild,rowRole,signed,viewSign] <;> omega
  · simp [s.cdLabel,columnRole]
  · simp [cparent,columnRole,signed]
  · exact opening_parent_before_child false h i _ _ _ _ _ _ _ rparent rchild (s.parent i hi)
  · exact column_dummy_before_variable h i _ _ _ false _ _ s.cdLabel cparent

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.path_horizontal_plus_guard
statement:
theorem path_horizontal_plus_guard (h i : Nat) (s : PathSelection h) (hi : i < h) :
    let k := 2 + s.node (i+1) % 2
    FrameGuard (matrix h)
      (four (s.ra (i+1) k 0) (s.ra (i+1) k 1) (s.row (i+1) true) s.rd)
      (four (s.ca (i+1) k 0) (s.ca (i+1) k 1) (s.col i true) (s.col (i+1) true))
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  have rchild := s.rowLabel (i+1) (by omega) true
  have cparent := s.colLabel i (by omega) true
  have cchild := s.colLabel (i+1) (by omega) true
  simp only [viewSign,ite_self] at rchild cparent cchild
  have hm : s.node (i+1) % 2 = 0 ∨ s.node (i+1) % 2 = 1 := by omega
  apply selected_guard h i _ s hi (by omega)
  · rcases hm with hm | hm <;> simp [rchild,rowRole,signed,hm]
  · rcases hm with hm | hm <;> simp [s.rdLabel,rowRole,hm]
  · rcases hm with hm | hm <;> simp [cparent,columnRole,signed,hm]
  · rcases hm with hm | hm <;> simp [cchild,columnRole,signed,hm]
  · exact variable_before_row_dummy h (i+1) _ _ _ true _ _ rchild s.rdLabel
  · exact opening_parent_before_child true h i _ _ _ _ true _ _ cparent cchild (s.parent i hi)

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.path_horizontal_minus_guard
statement:
theorem path_horizontal_minus_guard (h i : Nat) (s : PathSelection h) (hi : i < h) :
    let k := 4 + s.node (i+1) % 2
    FrameGuard (matrix h)
      (four (s.ra (i+1) k 0) (s.ra (i+1) k 1) (s.row (i+1) false) s.rd)
      (four (s.ca (i+1) k 0) (s.ca (i+1) k 1) (s.col (i+1) false) (s.col i false))
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  have rchild := s.rowLabel (i+1) (by omega) false
  have cparent := s.colLabel i (by omega) false
  have cchild := s.colLabel (i+1) (by omega) false
  simp only [viewSign,if_neg (Nat.ne_of_lt hi)] at cparent
  have hm : s.node (i+1) % 2 = 0 ∨ s.node (i+1) % 2 = 1 := by omega
  apply selected_guard h i _ s hi (by omega)
  · rcases hm with hm | hm <;> simp [rchild,rowRole,signed,viewSign,hm] <;> omega
  · rcases hm with hm | hm <;> simp [s.rdLabel,rowRole,hm]
  · rcases hm with hm | hm <;> simp [cchild,columnRole,signed,viewSign,hm] <;> omega
  · rcases hm with hm | hm <;> simp [cparent,columnRole,signed,hm]
  · exact variable_before_row_dummy h (i+1) _ _ _ _ _ _ rchild s.rdLabel
  · exact child_before_closing_parent true h i _ _ _ _ _ _ _ cchild cparent (s.parent i hi)

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.anchorLabel_ordinal
statement:
theorem anchorLabel_ordinal (h index : Nat) :
    ordinal (anchorLabel h index) = index / 2 ^ h
proof:
:= by
  simp only [anchorLabel, ordinal, anchorRank, Nat.add_sub_cancel]
  omega

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.anchorLabel_valid
statement:
theorem anchorLabel_valid (h index : Nat) :
    ∃ l k g a, anchorLabel h index = .anchor l k g a ∧
      1 ≤ l ∧ k < 6 ∧ g < 2
proof:
:= by
  have hu := Nat.zero_le ((index / 2 ^ h) / 12)
  have hm := Nat.mod_lt (index / 2 ^ h) (by decide : 0 < 12)
  have hg := Nat.mod_lt ((index / 2 ^ h) % 12) (by decide : 0 < 2)
  unfold anchorLabel
  refine ⟨_, _, _, _, rfl, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> omega

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.anchors_ordered
statement:
theorem anchors_ordered (h : Nat) :
    (anchors h).Pairwise (fun a b => ordinal a ≤ ordinal b)
proof:
:= by
  apply List.pairwise_iff_getElem.mpr
  intro i j hi hj hij
  simp only [anchors, List.getElem_map, List.getElem_range, anchorLabel_ordinal]
  exact Nat.div_le_div_right (Nat.le_of_lt hij)

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.tree_nonanchor
statement:
theorem tree_nonanchor (column : Bool) (rem depth node : Nat)
    (p : Position) (hp : p ∈ tree column rem depth node) : Nonanchor p
proof:
:= by
  induction rem generalizing depth node with
  | zero => have he := List.eq_of_mem_singleton hp; subst p; trivial
  | succ rem ih =>
    simp only [tree, List.mem_append] at hp
    rcases hp with ((hp | hp) | hp) | hp
    · simp only [block, List.mem_map] at hp
      rcases hp with ⟨a, _, rfl⟩; trivial
    · exact ih _ _ hp
    · exact ih _ _ hp
    · simp only [block, List.mem_map] at hp
      rcases hp with ⟨a, _, rfl⟩; trivial

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.tail_nonanchor
statement:
theorem tail_nonanchor (column : Bool) (h : Nat) (p : Position)
    (hp : p ∈ nonanchors column h) : Nonanchor p
proof:
:= by
  unfold nonanchors at hp
  cases column <;> simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, List.mem_append] at hp
  · rcases hp with ht | hd
    · exact tree_nonanchor false h 0 0 p ht
    · simp only [dummies, List.mem_map] at hd
      rcases hd with ⟨a, _, rfl⟩; trivial
  · rcases hp with hd | ht
    · simp only [dummies, List.mem_map] at hd
      rcases hd with ⟨a, _, rfl⟩; trivial
    · exact tree_nonanchor true h 0 0 p ht

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.anchor_index_lt
statement:
theorem anchor_index_lt (column : Bool) (h : Nat) (j : Fin (size h))
    (l k g a : Nat) (he : labelAt column h j = .anchor l k g a) :
    j.val < (anchors h).length
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hj : j.val < (anchors h).length
  · exact hj
  have hle : (anchors h).length ≤ j.val := by omega
  have he' := he
  rw [labelAt_append] at he'
  rw [List.getElem_append_right hle] at he'
  have hm := List.mem_of_getElem he'
  have hf := tail_nonanchor column h (.anchor l k g a) hm
  exact False.elim hf

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.anchor_index_ordinal
statement:
theorem anchor_index_ordinal (column : Bool) (h : Nat) (j : Fin (size h))
    (l k g a : Nat) (he : labelAt column h j = .anchor l k g a) :
    anchorRank (l - 1) k g = j.val / 2 ^ h
proof:
:= by
  have hj := anchor_index_lt column h j l k g a he
  have he' := he
  rw [labelAt_append] at he'
  rw [List.getElem_append_left hj] at he'
  have ho := congrArg ordinal he'
  simp only [anchors, List.getElem_map, List.getElem_range] at ho
  change ordinal (anchorLabel h j.val) = anchorRank (l - 1) k g at ho
  rw [anchorLabel_ordinal] at ho
  exact ho.symm

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.anchor_index_valid
statement:
theorem anchor_index_valid (column : Bool) (h : Nat) (j : Fin (size h))
    (l k g a : Nat) (he : labelAt column h j = .anchor l k g a) :
    1 ≤ l ∧ k < 6 ∧ g < 2
proof:
:= by
  have hj := anchor_index_lt column h j l k g a he
  have he' := he
  rw [labelAt_append] at he'
  rw [List.getElem_append_left hj] at he'
  simp only [anchors, List.getElem_map, List.getElem_range] at he'
  have hv := anchorLabel_valid h j.val
  rcases hv with ⟨l', k', g', a', heq, hl, hk, hg⟩
  rw [he'] at heq
  cases heq
  exact ⟨hl, hk, hg⟩

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.anchor_order_le
statement:
theorem anchor_order_le (column : Bool) (h : Nat) (x y : Fin (size h))
    (l k g a l' k' g' a' : Nat)
    (hx : labelAt column h x = .anchor l k g a)
    (hy : labelAt column h y = .anchor l' k' g' a') (hxy : x.val < y.val) :
    anchorRank (l - 1) k g ≤ anchorRank (l' - 1) k' g'
proof:
:= by
  rw [anchor_index_ordinal column h x l k g a hx,
      anchor_index_ordinal column h y l' k' g' a' hy]
  exact Nat.div_le_div_right (Nat.le_of_lt hxy)

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.four_increasing
statement:
theorem four_increasing {n : Nat} (a b c d : Fin n)
    (hab : a.val < b.val) (hbc : b.val < c.val) (hcd : c.val < d.val) :
    Increasing (four a b c d)
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hij
  have hi : i = 0 ∨ i = 1 ∨ i = 2 ∨ i = 3 := by omega
  have hj : j = 0 ∨ j = 1 ∨ j = 2 ∨ j = 3 := by omega
  rcases hi with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl <;> rcases hj with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
  all_goals simp [four] at * <;> omega

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.row_roles_disjoint
statement:
private theorem row_roles_disjoint (h l k : Nat) (r : Position)
    (h0 : rowRole h l k 0 r) (h1 : rowRole h l k 1 r) : False
proof:
:= by
  cases r <;> simp [rowRole] at h0 h1 <;> omega

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.column_roles_disjoint
statement:
private theorem column_roles_disjoint (h l k : Nat) (c : Position)
    (h0 : columnRole h l k 0 c) (h1 : columnRole h l k 1 c) : False
proof:
:= by
  cases c <;> simp [columnRole] at h0 h1 <;> omega

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.row_role_nonanchor
statement:
private theorem row_role_nonanchor (h l k g : Nat) (r : Position)
    (hr : rowRole h l k g r) : Nonanchor r
proof:
:= by
  cases r <;> simp_all [rowRole,Nonanchor]

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.column_role_nonanchor
statement:
private theorem column_role_nonanchor (h l k g : Nat) (c : Position)
    (hc : columnRole h l k g c) : Nonanchor c
proof:
:= by
  cases c <;> simp_all [columnRole,Nonanchor]

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.row_role_entries
statement:
private theorem row_role_entries (h l k a b : Nat) (r : Position) (g : Fin 2)
    (hr : rowRole h l k g.val r) :
    entry h r (.anchor l k 0 a) = decide (g.val = 0) ∧
    entry h r (.anchor l k 1 b) = decide (g.val = 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hg : g = 0 ∨ g = 1 := by omega
  rcases hg with rfl | rfl
  · have hn : ¬ rowRole h l k 1 r := row_roles_disjoint h l k r hr
    cases r <;> simp_all [entry,rowRole]
  · have hn : ¬ rowRole h l k 0 r := fun h0 => row_roles_disjoint h l k r h0 hr
    cases r <;> simp_all [entry,rowRole]

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.column_role_entries
statement:
private theorem column_role_entries (h l k a b : Nat) (c : Position) (g : Fin 2)
    (hc : columnRole h l k g.val c) :
    entry h (.anchor l k 0 a) c = decide (g.val = 0) ∧
    entry h (.anchor l k 1 b) c = decide (g.val = 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hg : g = 0 ∨ g = 1 := by omega
  rcases hg with rfl | rfl
  · have hn : ¬ columnRole h l k 1 c := column_roles_disjoint h l k c hc
    cases c <;> simp_all [entry,columnRole]
  · have hn : ¬ columnRole h l k 0 c := fun h0 => column_roles_disjoint h l k c h0 hc
    cases c <;> simp_all [entry,columnRole]

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.canonical_host_guard
statement:
theorem canonical_host_guard (h l k a b c d : Nat)
    (r0 r1 r2 r3 c0 c1 c2 c3 : Fin (size h))
    (hr0 : labelAt false h r0 = .anchor l k 0 a)
    (hr1 : labelAt false h r1 = .anchor l k 1 b)
    (hc0 : labelAt true h c0 = .anchor l k 0 c)
    (hc1 : labelAt true h c1 = .anchor l k 1 d)
    (rr0 : rowRole h l k 0 (labelAt false h r2))
    (rr1 : rowRole h l k 1 (labelAt false h r3))
    (cc0 : columnRole h l k 0 (labelAt true h c2))
    (cc1 : columnRole h l k 1 (labelAt true h c3))
    (hro : r2.val < r3.val) (hco : c2.val < c3.val) :
    FrameGuard (matrix h) (four r0 r1 r2 r3) (four c0 c1 c2 c3)
proof:
:= by
  have r0a : Anchor (labelAt false h r0) := by simp [hr0,Anchor]
  have r1a : Anchor (labelAt false h r1) := by simp [hr1,Anchor]
  have c0a : Anchor (labelAt true h c0) := by simp [hc0,Anchor]
  have c1a : Anchor (labelAt true h c1) := by simp [hc1,Anchor]
  have rb0 := row_role_entries h l k c d _ 0 rr0
  have rb1 := row_role_entries h l k c d _ 1 rr1
  have cb0 := column_role_entries h l k a b _ 0 cc0
  have cb1 := column_role_entries h l k a b _ 1 cc1
  refine ⟨four_increasing _ _ _ _ (anchor_group_order false h l k a b r0 r1 hr0 hr1)
    (anchor_before_nonanchor false h r1 r2 r1a (row_role_nonanchor h l k 0 _ rr0)) hro,
    four_increasing _ _ _ _ (anchor_group_order true h l k c d c0 c1 hc0 hc1)
    (anchor_before_nonanchor true h c1 c2 c1a (column_role_nonanchor h l k 0 _ cc0)) hco,?_⟩
  intro i j ha
  have hi : i = 0 ∨ i = 1 ∨ i = 2 ∨ i = 3 := by omega
  have hj : j = 0 ∨ j = 1 ∨ j = 2 ∨ j = 3 := by omega
  rcases hi with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl <;> rcases hj with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
  all_goals try omega
  all_goals simp [four]
  all_goals simp only [matrix,hr0,hr1,hc0,hc1]
  all_goals try simp only [rb0.1,rb0.2,rb1.1,rb1.2,cb0.1,cb0.2,cb1.1,cb1.2]
  all_goals try simp [entry,H4]
  all_goals rfl

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.nonterminal_siblings
statement:
theorem nonterminal_siblings (p q b : Nat) (hpq : p < q)
    (hqb : q / 2 ≤ b) (hbp : b ≤ p / 2) :
    p = 2 * b ∧ q = 2 * b + 1
proof:
:= by
  omega

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.equal_parity_parent_order
statement:
theorem equal_parity_parent_order (p q : Nat)
    (hparity : p % 2 = q % 2) (hparent : p / 2 ≤ q / 2) : p ≤ q
proof:
:= by
  omega

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.terminal_parent_equal
statement:
theorem terminal_parent_equal (p q b : Nat) (hpq : p ≤ q)
    (hqb : q / 2 ≤ b) (hbp : b ≤ p / 2) :
    p / 2 = b ∧ q / 2 = b
proof:
:= by
  omega

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.minus_one_cannot_precede_minus_zero
statement:
theorem minus_one_cannot_precede_minus_zero (level : Nat) :
    ¬ anchorRank level 5 0 < anchorRank level 4 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold anchorRank
  omega

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.next_level_anchor_cannot_precede
statement:
theorem next_level_anchor_cannot_precede (level next kind group : Nat)
    (hnext : level < next) :
    ¬ anchorRank next kind group < anchorRank level 4 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold anchorRank
  omega

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.mem_copies
statement: theorem mem_copies (h : Nat) (e : Embedding h) : e ∈ copies h ↔ Copy h e.1 e.2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rcases e with ⟨rows,cols⟩
  simp [copies,mem_cartesian,mem_assignments]

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.copies_nodup
statement: theorem copies_nodup (h : Nat) : (copies h).Nodup
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact List.Pairwise.filter _ (cartesian_nodup _ _ (assignments_nodup _ _) (assignments_nodup _ _))

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.rebuild_remainder
statement:
theorem rebuild_remainder (h : Nat) (e : Embedding h) :
    rebuild h (e.1 2,e.2 3) (remainder h e) = e
proof:
:= by
  apply Prod.ext <;> funext i
  all_goals have hi : i = 0 ∨ i = 1 ∨ i = 2 ∨ i = 3 := by omega
  all_goals rcases hi with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl <;> simp [rebuild,remainder]

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.copyCandidates_length
statement:
theorem copyCandidates_length (h : Nat) (hh : 1 ≤ h) :
    (copyCandidates h hh).length = 2 * 2 ^ h * (size h) ^ 6
proof:
:= by
  simp [copyCandidates,List.length_flatMap,assignments_length,List.map_const',
    List.sum_replicate_nat,sparseCells_length]

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.copies_subset_candidates
statement: theorem copies_subset_candidates (h : Nat) (hh : 1 ≤ h) : copies h ⊆ copyCandidates h hh
proof:
:= by
  intro e he
  have hc := (mem_copies h e).mp he
  have hz := all_copy_localization h hh e.1 e.2 hc
  exact List.mem_flatMap.mpr ⟨(e.1 2,e.2 3),(mem_sparseCells_iff h hh _ _).mpr hz,
    List.mem_map.mpr ⟨remainder h e,mem_assignments _ _ _,rebuild_remainder h e⟩⟩

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.copy_count_bound
statement:
theorem copy_count_bound (h : Nat) (hh : 1 ≤ h) :
    copyCount h ≤ 2 * 2 ^ h * (size h) ^ 6
proof:
:= by
  have hb := (copies_nodup h).length_le_of_subset (copies_subset_candidates h hh)
  simpa only [copyCount,copyCandidates_length] using hb

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.tree_variable
statement:
theorem tree_variable (column : Bool) (rem depth node : Nat)
    (p : Position) (hp : p ∈ tree column rem depth node) : IsVariable p
proof:
:= by
  induction rem generalizing depth node with
  | zero => have he := List.eq_of_mem_singleton hp; subst p; trivial
  | succ rem ih =>
    simp only [tree, List.mem_append] at hp
    rcases hp with ((hp | hp) | hp) | hp
    · simp only [block, List.mem_map] at hp
      rcases hp with ⟨a, _, rfl⟩; trivial
    · exact ih _ _ hp
    · exact ih _ _ hp
    · simp only [block, List.mem_map] at hp
      rcases hp with ⟨a, _, rfl⟩; trivial

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.tree_location
statement:
theorem tree_location (column : Bool) (rem depth node j : Nat)
    (s : Bool) (q a : Nat) (hm : .variable j s q a ∈ tree column rem depth node) :
    depth ≤ j ∧ ancestor (j - depth) q = node
proof:
:= by
  induction rem generalizing depth node with
  | zero =>
    have he := List.eq_of_mem_singleton hm
    cases he
    simp [ancestor]
  | succ rem ih =>
    simp only [tree, List.mem_append] at hm
    rcases hm with ((hm | hm) | hm) | hm
    · simp only [block, List.mem_map] at hm
      rcases hm with ⟨b, _, he⟩
      cases he
      simp [ancestor]
    · have ht := ih _ _ hm
      have hd : j - depth = (j - (depth + 1)) + 1 := by omega
      rw [hd, ancestor, ht.2]
      constructor <;> omega
    · have ht := ih _ _ hm
      have hd : j - depth = (j - (depth + 1)) + 1 := by omega
      rw [hd, ancestor, ht.2]
      constructor <;> omega
    · simp only [block, List.mem_map] at hm
      rcases hm with ⟨b, _, he⟩
      cases he
      simp [ancestor]

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.block_nodup
statement:
theorem block_nodup (depth : Nat) (s : Bool) (node size : Nat) :
    (block depth s node size).Nodup
proof:
:= by
  apply List.Pairwise.map _ _ List.nodup_range
  intro a b hab he
  exact hab (Position.variable.inj he).2.2.2

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.block_child_disjoint
statement:
private theorem block_child_disjoint (column : Bool) (rem depth node child : Nat)
    (s : Bool) (size : Nat) (x : Position)
    (hb : x ∈ block depth s node size)
    (ht : x ∈ tree column rem (depth + 1) child) : False
proof:
:= by
  simp only [block, List.mem_map] at hb
  rcases hb with ⟨a, _, rfl⟩
  have hd := (tree_location column rem (depth + 1) child depth s node a ht).1
  omega

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.children_disjoint
proof:
:= by
  have hn := tree_variable column rem (depth + 1) (2 * node) x h0
  cases x with
  | anchor => contradiction
  | dummy => contradiction
  | «variable» j s q a =>
    have hl := (tree_location column rem (depth + 1) (2 * node) j s q a h0).2
    have hr := (tree_location column rem (depth + 1) (2 * node + 1) j s q a h1).2
    omega

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.tree_nodup
statement:
theorem tree_nodup (column : Bool) (rem depth node : Nat) :
    (tree column rem depth node).Nodup
proof:
:= by
  induction rem generalizing depth node with
  | zero => simp [tree]
  | succ rem ih =>
    have hab : (block depth column node (2 ^ (rem + 1)) ++
        tree column rem (depth + 1) (2 * node)).Nodup := by
      apply List.nodup_append.mpr
      refine ⟨block_nodup .., ih .., ?_⟩
      intro x hx y hy he
      subst y
      exact block_child_disjoint column rem depth node (2 * node) column _ x hx hy
    have habc : ((block depth column node (2 ^ (rem + 1)) ++
        tree column rem (depth + 1) (2 * node)) ++
        tree column rem (depth + 1) (2 * node + 1)).Nodup := by
      apply List.nodup_append.mpr
      refine ⟨hab, ih .., ?_⟩
      intro x hx y hy he
      subst y
      rcases List.mem_append.mp hx with hx | hx
      · exact block_child_disjoint column rem depth node (2 * node + 1) column _ x hx hy
      · exact children_disjoint column rem depth node x hx hy
    unfold tree
    apply List.nodup_append.mpr
    refine ⟨habc, block_nodup .., ?_⟩
    intro x hx y hy he
    subst y
    rcases List.mem_append.mp hx with hx | hx
    · rcases List.mem_append.mp hx with hx | hx
      · simp only [block, List.mem_map] at hx hy
        rcases hx with ⟨a, _, rfl⟩
        rcases hy with ⟨b, _, he⟩
        cases column <;> simp at he
      · exact block_child_disjoint column rem depth node (2 * node) (!column) _ x hy hx
    · exact block_child_disjoint column rem depth node (2 * node + 1) (!column) _ x hy hx

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.anchorLabel_injective
statement:
theorem anchorLabel_injective (h i j : Nat) (he : anchorLabel h i = anchorLabel h j) :
    i = j
proof:
:= by
  have ho := congrArg ordinal he
  rw [anchorLabel_ordinal, anchorLabel_ordinal] at ho
  have ha : i % 2 ^ h = j % 2 ^ h := by
    simp only [anchorLabel, Position.anchor.injEq] at he
    exact he.2.2.2
  have hi := Nat.mod_add_div i (2 ^ h)
  have hj := Nat.mod_add_div j (2 ^ h)
  rw [ho, ha] at hi
  omega

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.anchors_nodup
statement: theorem anchors_nodup (h : Nat) : (anchors h).Nodup
proof:
:= by
  apply List.Pairwise.map _ _ List.nodup_range
  intro i j hij he
  exact hij (anchorLabel_injective h i j he)

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.dummies_nodup
statement: theorem dummies_nodup (h : Nat) : (dummies h).Nodup
proof:
:= by
  apply List.Pairwise.map _ _ List.nodup_range
  intro i j hij he
  exact hij (Position.dummy.inj he)

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.tree_dummy_disjoint
statement:
private theorem tree_dummy_disjoint (column : Bool) (h : Nat) (x y : Position)
    (hx : x ∈ tree column h 0 0) (hy : y ∈ dummies h) : x ≠ y
proof:
:= by
  intro he
  subst y
  have hv := tree_variable column h 0 0 x hx
  simp only [dummies, List.mem_map] at hy
  rcases hy with ⟨a, _, rfl⟩
  contradiction

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.nonanchors_nodup
statement:
theorem nonanchors_nodup (column : Bool) (h : Nat) :
    (nonanchors column h).Nodup
proof:
:= by
  cases column <;> unfold nonanchors <;> simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte]
  · apply List.nodup_append.mpr
    refine ⟨tree_nodup .., dummies_nodup h, ?_⟩
    intro x hx y hy
    exact tree_dummy_disjoint false h x y hx hy
  · apply List.nodup_append.mpr
    refine ⟨dummies_nodup h, tree_nodup .., ?_⟩
    intro x hx y hy he
    exact tree_dummy_disjoint true h y x hy hx he.symm

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.axis_nodup
statement: theorem axis_nodup (column : Bool) (h : Nat) : (axis column h).Nodup
proof:
:= by
  apply List.nodup_append.mpr
  refine ⟨anchors_nodup h, nonanchors_nodup column h, ?_⟩
  intro x hx y hy he
  subst y
  have hn := tail_nonanchor column h x hy
  simp only [anchors, List.mem_map] at hx
  rcases hx with ⟨index, _, rfl⟩
  unfold anchorLabel at hn
  contradiction

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.labelAt_injective
statement:
theorem labelAt_injective (column : Bool) (h : Nat) (i j : Fin (size h))
    (he : labelAt column h i = labelAt column h j) : i = j
proof:
:= by
  apply Fin.ext
  exact (axis_nodup column h).getElem_inj.mp he

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.anchor_exists
statement:
theorem anchor_exists (p : Position) (hp : Anchor p) :
    ∃ l k g a, p = .anchor l k g a
proof:
:= by
  cases p with
  | anchor l k g a => exact ⟨l,k,g,a,rfl⟩
  | dummy => contradiction
  | «variable» => contradiction

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.anchor_iff_not_nonanchor
statement: theorem anchor_iff_not_nonanchor (p : Position) : Anchor p ↔ ¬ Nonanchor p
proof:
:= by
  cases p <;> simp [Anchor, Nonanchor]

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.anchor_of_index_lt
statement:
theorem anchor_of_index_lt (column : Bool) (h : Nat) (j : Fin (size h))
    (hj : j.val < (anchors h).length) : Anchor (labelAt column h j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [labelAt_append, List.getElem_append_left hj]
  simp only [anchors, List.getElem_map, List.getElem_range, anchorLabel, Anchor]

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.anchor_iff_index_lt
statement:
theorem anchor_iff_index_lt (column : Bool) (h : Nat) (j : Fin (size h)) :
    Anchor (labelAt column h j) ↔ j.val < (anchors h).length
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro ha
    rcases anchor_exists _ ha with ⟨l,k,g,a,he⟩
    exact anchor_index_lt column h j l k g a he
  · exact anchor_of_index_lt column h j

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.nonanchor_later
statement:
theorem nonanchor_later (column : Bool) (h : Nat) (x y : Fin (size h))
    (hxy : x.val < y.val) (hx : Nonanchor (labelAt column h x)) :
    Nonanchor (labelAt column h y)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hy : Anchor (labelAt column h y)
  · have hj := (anchor_iff_index_lt column h y).mp hy
    have hxi := anchor_of_index_lt column h x (by omega)
    exact False.elim ((anchor_iff_not_nonanchor _).mp hxi hx)
  · cases he : labelAt column h y <;> simp_all [Anchor, Nonanchor]

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.anchor_column_connects
statement:
theorem anchor_column_connects (h : Nat) (x y c : Fin (size h))
    (ha : Anchor (labelAt true h c))
    (hx : Nonanchor (labelAt false h x)) (hy : Nonanchor (labelAt false h y))
    (h0 : matrix h x c = true) (h1 : matrix h y c = true) :
    SameClass (labelAt false h x) (labelAt false h y)
proof:
:= by
  rcases anchor_exists _ ha with ⟨l,k,g,a,he⟩
  apply row_role_same_class h l k g _ _ (labelAt_valid false h x) (labelAt_valid false h y)
  · have hbit : entry h (labelAt false h x) (.anchor l k g a) = true := by
      simpa only [matrix, he] using h0
    cases hp : labelAt false h x <;> simp_all [Nonanchor, entry] 
  · have hbit : entry h (labelAt false h y) (.anchor l k g a) = true := by
      simpa only [matrix, he] using h1
    cases hp : labelAt false h y <;> simp_all [Nonanchor, entry]

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.anchor_row_connects
statement:
theorem anchor_row_connects (h : Nat) (r x y : Fin (size h))
    (ha : Anchor (labelAt false h r))
    (hx : Nonanchor (labelAt true h x)) (hy : Nonanchor (labelAt true h y))
    (h0 : matrix h r x = true) (h1 : matrix h r y = true) :
    SameClass (labelAt true h x) (labelAt true h y)
proof:
:= by
  rcases anchor_exists _ ha with ⟨l,k,g,a,he⟩
  apply column_role_same_class h l k g _ _ (labelAt_valid true h x) (labelAt_valid true h y)
  · have hbit : entry h (.anchor l k g a) (labelAt true h x) = true := by
      simpa only [matrix, he] using h0
    cases hp : labelAt true h x <;> simp_all [Nonanchor, entry]
  · have hbit : entry h (.anchor l k g a) (labelAt true h y) = true := by
      simpa only [matrix, he] using h1
    cases hp : labelAt true h y <;> simp_all [Nonanchor, entry]

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.second_row_anchor
statement:
theorem second_row_anchor (h : Nat) (rows cols : Fin 4 → Fin (size h)) (hc : Copy h rows cols) :
    Anchor (labelAt false h (rows 1))
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ha : Anchor (labelAt false h (rows 1))
  · exact ha
  · have hn1 : Nonanchor (labelAt false h (rows 1)) := by
      cases he : labelAt false h (rows 1) <;> simp_all [Anchor, Nonanchor]
    have hn2 := nonanchor_later false h (rows 1) (rows 2) (hc.1 1 2 (by decide)) hn1
    have hn3 := nonanchor_later false h (rows 1) (rows 3) (hc.1 1 3 (by decide)) hn1
    by_cases hb0 : Anchor (labelAt true h (cols 0))
    · have hs12 := anchor_column_connects h (rows 1) (rows 2) (cols 0) hb0 hn1 hn2 (hc.2.2 1 0) (hc.2.2 2 0)
      by_cases hb2 : Anchor (labelAt true h (cols 2))
      · have hs23 := anchor_column_connects h (rows 2) (rows 3) (cols 2) hb2 hn2 hn3 (hc.2.2 2 2) (hc.2.2 3 2)
        have hs13 := sameClass_trans _ _ _ hs12 hs23
        have ht := same_class_three_row_signatures h _ _ _ hs12 hs13 hs23
        rcases anchor_exists _ hb0 with ⟨l0,k0,g0,a0,he0⟩
        rcases anchor_exists _ hb2 with ⟨l2,k2,g2,a2,he2⟩
        rcases ht with ht | ht | ht
        · have he := ht l2 k2 g2 a2
          have hm1 := hc.2.2 1 2
          have hm2 := hc.2.2 2 2
          simp only [matrix, he2] at hm1 hm2
          rw [hm1, hm2] at he
          contradiction
        · have he := ht l0 k0 g0 a0
          have hm1 := hc.2.2 1 0
          have hm3 := hc.2.2 3 0
          simp only [matrix, he0] at hm1 hm3
          rw [hm1, hm3] at he
          contradiction
        · have he := ht l0 k0 g0 a0
          have hm2 := hc.2.2 2 0
          have hm3 := hc.2.2 3 0
          simp only [matrix, he0] at hm2 hm3
          rw [hm2, hm3] at he
          contradiction
      · have hncol2 : Nonanchor (labelAt true h (cols 2)) := by
          cases he : labelAt true h (cols 2) <;> simp_all [Anchor, Nonanchor]
        have hncol3 := nonanchor_later true h (cols 2) (cols 3) (hc.2.1 2 3 (by decide)) hncol2
        exact False.elim (same_class_rows_no_cross h _ _ _ _ hs12 hncol3 hncol2
          (hc.2.2 1 3) (hc.2.2 2 3) (hc.2.2 1 2) (hc.2.2 2 2))
    · have hncol0 : Nonanchor (labelAt true h (cols 0)) := by
        cases he : labelAt true h (cols 0) <;> simp_all [Anchor, Nonanchor]
      have hcols : ∀ i : Fin 4, Nonanchor (labelAt true h (cols i)) := by
        intro i
        by_cases hi : i = 0
        · simpa [hi] using hncol0
        · exact nonanchor_later true h (cols 0) (cols i) (hc.2.1 0 i (by omega)) hncol0
      let rr : Fin 3 → Fin 4 := fun i => ⟨i.val + 1, by omega⟩
      let cc : Fin 3 → Fin 4 := fun i =>
        if i = 0 then 2 else if i = 1 then 3 else 0
      apply False.elim
      apply nonanchor_crown_exclusion h (fun i => rows (rr i)) (fun i => cols (cc i))
      · intro i
        have hi : i = 0 ∨ i = 1 ∨ i = 2 := by omega
        rcases hi with rfl | rfl | rfl
        · exact hn1
        · exact hn2
        · exact hn3
      · intro i; exact hcols _
      · intro i j
        have hm := hc.2.2 (rr i) (cc j)
        have hpattern : H4 (rr i) (cc j) = decide (i ≠ j) := by
          have hi : i = 0 ∨ i = 1 ∨ i = 2 := by omega
          have hj : j = 0 ∨ j = 1 ∨ j = 2 := by omega
          rcases hi with rfl | rfl | rfl <;> rcases hj with rfl | rfl | rfl <;> decide
        exact hm.trans hpattern

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.first_row_anchor
statement:
theorem first_row_anchor (h : Nat) (rows cols : Fin 4 → Fin (size h)) (hc : Copy h rows cols) :
    Anchor (labelAt false h (rows 0))
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := (anchor_iff_index_lt false h (rows 1)).mp (second_row_anchor h rows cols hc)
  apply anchor_of_index_lt
  have hi := hc.1 0 1 (by decide)
  omega

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.first_column_anchor
statement:
theorem first_column_anchor (h : Nat) (rows cols : Fin 4 → Fin (size h)) (hc : Copy h rows cols) :
    Anchor (labelAt true h (cols 0))
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ha : Anchor (labelAt true h (cols 0))
  · exact ha
  have hn0 : Nonanchor (labelAt true h (cols 0)) := by
    cases he : labelAt true h (cols 0) <;> simp_all [Anchor, Nonanchor]
  have hncols : ∀ i : Fin 4, Nonanchor (labelAt true h (cols i)) := by
    intro i
    by_cases hi : i = 0
    · simpa [hi] using hn0
    · exact nonanchor_later true h (cols 0) (cols i) (hc.2.1 0 i (by omega)) hn0
  have hr0 := first_row_anchor h rows cols hc
  have hr1 := second_row_anchor h rows cols hc
  by_cases hr2 : Anchor (labelAt false h (rows 2))
  · have h12 := anchor_row_connects h (rows 0) (cols 1) (cols 2) hr0
      (hncols 1) (hncols 2) (hc.2.2 0 1) (hc.2.2 0 2)
    have h02 := anchor_row_connects h (rows 2) (cols 0) (cols 2) hr2
      (hncols 0) (hncols 2) (hc.2.2 2 0) (hc.2.2 2 2)
    have h01 := sameClass_trans _ _ _ h02 (sameClass_symm _ _ h12)
    have ht := same_class_three_column_signatures h _ _ _ h01 h02 h12
    rcases anchor_exists _ hr0 with ⟨l0,k0,g0,a0,he0⟩
    rcases anchor_exists _ hr2 with ⟨l2,k2,g2,a2,he2⟩
    apply False.elim
    rcases ht with ht | ht | ht
    · have he := ht l0 k0 g0 a0
      have hm0 := hc.2.2 0 0
      have hm1 := hc.2.2 0 1
      simp only [matrix, he0] at hm0 hm1
      rw [hm0, hm1] at he
      contradiction
    · have he := ht l0 k0 g0 a0
      have hm0 := hc.2.2 0 0
      have hm2 := hc.2.2 0 2
      simp only [matrix, he0] at hm0 hm2
      rw [hm0, hm2] at he
      contradiction
    · have he := ht l2 k2 g2 a2
      have hm1 := hc.2.2 2 1
      have hm2 := hc.2.2 2 2
      simp only [matrix, he2] at hm1 hm2
      rw [hm1, hm2] at he
      contradiction
  · have hn2 : Nonanchor (labelAt false h (rows 2)) := by
      cases he : labelAt false h (rows 2) <;> simp_all [Anchor, Nonanchor]
    have hn3 := nonanchor_later false h (rows 2) (rows 3) (hc.1 2 3 (by decide)) hn2
    have hclass := anchor_row_connects h (rows 1) (cols 0) (cols 3) hr1
      (hncols 0) (hncols 3) (hc.2.2 1 0) (hc.2.2 1 3)
    exact False.elim (same_class_columns_no_cross h _ _ _ _ hclass hn2 hn3
      (hc.2.2 2 0) (hc.2.2 2 3) (hc.2.2 3 0) (hc.2.2 3 3))

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.anchor_rows_common_one_twins
statement:
theorem anchor_rows_common_one_twins (h : Nat) (x y c : Fin (size h))
    (hx : Anchor (labelAt false h x)) (hy : Anchor (labelAt false h y))
    (hc : Anchor (labelAt true h c)) (h0 : matrix h x c = true) (h1 : matrix h y c = true) :
    ∀ z, matrix h x z = matrix h y z
proof:
:= by
  rcases anchor_exists _ hx with ⟨l,k,g,a,he0⟩
  rcases anchor_exists _ hy with ⟨l',k',g',a',he1⟩
  rcases anchor_exists _ hc with ⟨u,v,w,b,hec⟩
  have hv0 := anchor_index_valid false h x l k g a he0
  have hv1 := anchor_index_valid false h y l' k' g' a' he1
  have hvc := anchor_index_valid true h c u v w b hec
  simp only [matrix, he0, he1, hec, entry, decide_eq_true_eq] at h0 h1
  have heq : l = l' ∧ k = k' ∧ g = g' := by omega
  rcases heq with ⟨rfl,rfl,rfl⟩
  intro z
  simp only [matrix, he0, he1]
  exact anchor_row_twins ..

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.anchor_columns_common_one_twins
statement:
theorem anchor_columns_common_one_twins (h : Nat) (r x y : Fin (size h))
    (hr : Anchor (labelAt false h r)) (hx : Anchor (labelAt true h x))
    (hy : Anchor (labelAt true h y)) (h0 : matrix h r x = true) (h1 : matrix h r y = true) :
    ∀ z, matrix h z x = matrix h z y
proof:
:= by
  rcases anchor_exists _ hx with ⟨l,k,g,a,he0⟩
  rcases anchor_exists _ hy with ⟨l',k',g',a',he1⟩
  rcases anchor_exists _ hr with ⟨u,v,w,b,her⟩
  have hv0 := anchor_index_valid true h x l k g a he0
  have hv1 := anchor_index_valid true h y l' k' g' a' he1
  have hvr := anchor_index_valid false h r u v w b her
  simp only [matrix, he0, he1, her, entry, decide_eq_true_eq] at h0 h1
  have heq : l = l' ∧ k = k' ∧ g = g' := by omega
  rcases heq with ⟨rfl,rfl,rfl⟩
  intro z
  simp only [matrix, he0, he1]
  exact anchor_column_twins ..

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.third_row_nonanchor
statement:
theorem third_row_nonanchor (h : Nat) (rows cols : Fin 4 → Fin (size h)) (hc : Copy h rows cols) :
    Nonanchor (labelAt false h (rows 2))
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ha : Anchor (labelAt false h (rows 2))
  · have ht := anchor_rows_common_one_twins h (rows 1) (rows 2) (cols 0)
      (second_row_anchor h rows cols hc) ha (first_column_anchor h rows cols hc)
      (hc.2.2 1 0) (hc.2.2 2 0) (cols 3)
    rw [hc.2.2 1 3, hc.2.2 2 3] at ht
    contradiction
  · cases he : labelAt false h (rows 2) <;> simp_all [Anchor, Nonanchor]

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.third_column_nonanchor
statement:
theorem third_column_nonanchor (h : Nat) (rows cols : Fin 4 → Fin (size h)) (hc : Copy h rows cols) :
    Nonanchor (labelAt true h (cols 2))
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ha : Anchor (labelAt true h (cols 2))
  · have hj := (anchor_iff_index_lt true h (cols 2)).mp ha
    have hinc := hc.2.1 1 2 (by decide)
    have ha1 := anchor_of_index_lt true h (cols 1) (by omega)
    have ht := anchor_columns_common_one_twins h (rows 0) (cols 1) (cols 2)
      (first_row_anchor h rows cols hc) ha1 ha (hc.2.2 0 1) (hc.2.2 0 2) (rows 2)
    rw [hc.2.2 2 1, hc.2.2 2 2] at ht
    contradiction
  · cases he : labelAt true h (cols 2) <;> simp_all [Anchor, Nonanchor]

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.copy_anchor_shape
statement:
theorem copy_anchor_shape (h : Nat) (rows cols : Fin 4 → Fin (size h)) (hc : Copy h rows cols) :
    Anchor (labelAt false h (rows 0)) ∧ Anchor (labelAt false h (rows 1)) ∧
    Nonanchor (labelAt false h (rows 2)) ∧ Nonanchor (labelAt false h (rows 3)) ∧
    Anchor (labelAt true h (cols 0)) ∧ Nonanchor (labelAt true h (cols 2)) ∧
    Nonanchor (labelAt true h (cols 3))
proof:
:= by
  have hr2 := third_row_nonanchor h rows cols hc
  have hc2 := third_column_nonanchor h rows cols hc
  exact ⟨first_row_anchor h rows cols hc, second_row_anchor h rows cols hc, hr2,
    nonanchor_later false h (rows 2) (rows 3) (hc.1 2 3 (by decide)) hr2,
    first_column_anchor h rows cols hc, hc2,
    nonanchor_later true h (cols 2) (cols 3) (hc.2.1 2 3 (by decide)) hc2⟩

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.nonanchor_row_role_of_entry
statement:
theorem nonanchor_row_role_of_entry (h l k g a : Nat) (r : Position)
    (hr : Nonanchor r) (he : entry h r (.anchor l k g a) = true) : rowRole h l k g r
proof:
:= by
  cases r <;> simp_all [Nonanchor, entry]

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.nonanchor_column_role_of_entry
statement:
theorem nonanchor_column_role_of_entry (h l k g a : Nat) (c : Position)
    (hc : Nonanchor c) (he : entry h (.anchor l k g a) c = true) : columnRole h l k g c
proof:
:= by
  cases c <;> simp_all [Nonanchor, entry]

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.reversed_body_roles_one
statement:
theorem reversed_body_roles_one (h l k : Nat) (r c : Position)
    (hr : rowRole h l k 1 r) (hc : columnRole h l k 0 c) : entry h r c = true
proof:
:= by
  cases r <;> cases c <;> simp_all [rowRole, columnRole, entry] <;> omega

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.second_row_first_column_groups
statement:
theorem second_row_first_column_groups (h : Nat) (rows cols : Fin 4 → Fin (size h))
    (hc : Copy h rows cols) (l k g a u v w b : Nat)
    (hr1 : labelAt false h (rows 1) = .anchor l k g a)
    (hc0 : labelAt true h (cols 0) = .anchor u v w b) :
    l = u ∧ k = v ∧ g = 1 ∧ w = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hvg := (anchor_index_valid false h (rows 1) l k g a hr1).2.2
  have hvw := (anchor_index_valid true h (cols 0) u v w b hc0).2.2
  have hm : matrix h (rows 1) (cols 0) = true := hc.2.2 1 0
  simp only [matrix, hr1, hc0, entry, decide_eq_true_eq] at hm
  have hlu := hm.1
  have hkv := hm.2.1
  subst u
  subst v
  by_cases hw : w = 0
  · exact ⟨rfl,rfl,by omega,hw⟩
  · have hw1 : w = 1 := by omega
    have hg0 : g = 0 := by omega
    subst w
    subst g
    have hshape := copy_anchor_shape h rows cols hc
    have hrbit := hc.2.2 2 0
    have hcbit := hc.2.2 1 3
    simp only [matrix, hr1, hc0] at hrbit hcbit
    have hrr := nonanchor_row_role_of_entry h l k 1 b _ hshape.2.2.1 hrbit
    have hcc := nonanchor_column_role_of_entry h l k 0 a _ hshape.2.2.2.2.2.2 hcbit
    have hone := reversed_body_roles_one h l k _ _ hrr hcc
    have hzero := hc.2.2 2 3
    change entry h (labelAt false h (rows 2)) (labelAt true h (cols 3)) = false at hzero
    rw [hzero] at hone
    contradiction

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.assignments_length
statement: theorem assignments_length (n k : Nat) : (assignments n k).length = n ^ k
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp [assignments]
  | succ k ih =>
    simp [assignments, List.length_flatMap, ih, List.map_const', List.sum_replicate_nat,
      Nat.pow_succ, Nat.mul_comm]

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.mem_assignments
statement: theorem mem_assignments (n k : Nat) (f : Fin k → Fin n) : f ∈ assignments n k
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    have hf : f = Fin.elim0 := funext (fun i => Fin.elim0 i)
    simp [assignments,hf]
  | succ k ih =>
    have he : (fun i => Fin.cases (f 0) (fun j => f j.succ) i) = f := by
      funext i
      exact Fin.cases rfl (fun _ => rfl) i
    exact List.mem_flatMap.mpr ⟨f 0,List.mem_finRange _,
      List.mem_map.mpr ⟨_,ih _,he⟩⟩

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.assignments_nodup
statement: theorem assignments_nodup (n k : Nat) : (assignments n k).Nodup
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp [assignments]
  | succ k ih =>
    apply List.pairwise_flatMap.mpr
    constructor
    · intro a ha
      apply List.Pairwise.map _ _ ih
      intro f g hfg he
      apply hfg
      funext i
      exact congrArg (fun u => u i.succ) he
    · apply (List.nodup_finRange n).imp
      intro a b hab x hx y hy he
      rcases List.mem_map.mp hx with ⟨f,hf,rfl⟩
      rcases List.mem_map.mp hy with ⟨g,hg,rfl⟩
      exact hab (congrArg (fun f => f 0) he)

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.cartesian_length
statement:
theorem cartesian_length {α β : Type} (l : List α) (m : List β) :
    (cartesian l m).length = l.length * m.length
proof:
:= by
  simp [cartesian,List.length_flatMap,List.map_const',List.sum_replicate_nat]

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.mem_cartesian
statement:
theorem mem_cartesian {α β : Type} (l : List α) (m : List β) (a : α) (b : β) :
    (a,b) ∈ cartesian l m ↔ a ∈ l ∧ b ∈ m
proof:
:= by
  simp [cartesian]

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.cartesian_nodup
statement:
theorem cartesian_nodup {α β : Type} (l : List α) (m : List β)
    (hl : l.Nodup) (hm : m.Nodup) : (cartesian l m).Nodup
proof:
:= by
  apply List.pairwise_flatMap.mpr
  constructor
  · intro a ha
    exact List.Pairwise.map _ (fun b c hbc he => hbc (congrArg Prod.snd he)) hm
  · apply hl.imp
    intro a b hab x hx y hy he
    rcases List.mem_map.mp hx with ⟨c,hc,rfl⟩
    rcases List.mem_map.mp hy with ⟨d,hd,rfl⟩
    exact hab (congrArg Prod.fst he)

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.traversal_refl
statement: private theorem traversal_refl (column : Bool) (p : Position) : TraversalOrdered column p p
proof:
:= by
  cases p <;> simp [TraversalOrdered]

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.index_lt_of_no_reverse
statement:
private theorem index_lt_of_no_reverse (column : Bool) (h : Nat) (x y : Fin (size h))
    (hn : ¬ TraversalOrdered column (labelAt column h y) (labelAt column h x)) : x.val < y.val
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hl : x.val < y.val
  · exact hl
  · by_cases he : x = y
    · subst y; exact False.elim (hn (traversal_refl column _))
    · exact False.elim (hn (indexed_traversal_ordered column h y x (by omega)))

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.opening_parent_before_child
statement:
theorem opening_parent_before_child (column : Bool) (h i p q a b : Nat) (s : Bool)
    (x y : Fin (size h)) (hx : labelAt column h x = .variable i column p a)
    (hy : labelAt column h y = .variable (i + 1) s q b) (hp : q / 2 = p) :
    x.val < y.val
proof:
:= by
  apply index_lt_of_no_reverse column h x y
  rw [hx,hy]
  simp [TraversalOrdered,ancestor]
  omega

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.child_before_closing_parent
statement:
theorem child_before_closing_parent (column : Bool) (h i p q a b : Nat) (s : Bool)
    (x y : Fin (size h)) (hx : labelAt column h x = .variable (i + 1) s q a)
    (hy : labelAt column h y = .variable i (!column) p b) (hp : q / 2 = p) :
    x.val < y.val
proof:
:= by
  apply index_lt_of_no_reverse column h x y
  rw [hx,hy]
  cases column <;> simp [TraversalOrdered,ancestor] <;> omega

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.opening_before_closing
statement:
theorem opening_before_closing (column : Bool) (h i p a b : Nat)
    (x y : Fin (size h)) (hx : labelAt column h x = .variable i column p a)
    (hy : labelAt column h y = .variable i (!column) p b) : x.val < y.val
proof:
:= by
  apply index_lt_of_no_reverse column h x y
  rw [hx,hy]
  cases column <;> simp [TraversalOrdered]

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.anchor_before_nonanchor
statement:
theorem anchor_before_nonanchor (column : Bool) (h : Nat) (x y : Fin (size h))
    (hx : Anchor (labelAt column h x)) (hy : Nonanchor (labelAt column h y)) : x.val < y.val
proof:
:= by
  have hxi := (anchor_iff_index_lt column h x).mp hx
  have hyi : ¬ y.val < (anchors h).length := by
    intro he; exact (anchor_iff_not_nonanchor _).mp (anchor_of_index_lt column h y he) hy
  omega

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.anchor_group_order
statement:
theorem anchor_group_order (column : Bool) (h l k a b : Nat)
    (x y : Fin (size h)) (hx : labelAt column h x = .anchor l k 0 a)
    (hy : labelAt column h y = .anchor l k 1 b) : x.val < y.val
proof:
:= by
  have h0 := anchor_index_ordinal column h x l k 0 a hx
  have h1 := anchor_index_ordinal column h y l k 1 b hy
  unfold anchorRank at h0 h1
  by_cases hlt : x.val < y.val
  · exact hlt
  · have hmono := Nat.div_le_div_right (c := 2 ^ h) (show y.val ≤ x.val from by omega)
    omega

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.constant_phase_pairwise
proof:
:= by
  apply List.pairwise_iff_getElem.mpr
  intro i j hi hj hij
  rw [hk _ (List.getElem_mem hi),hk _ (List.getElem_mem hj)]
  exact Nat.le_refl k

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.phase_pairwise_append
proof:
:= by
  apply List.pairwise_append.mpr
  refine ⟨constant_phase_pairwise column xs a ha,constant_phase_pairwise column ys b hb,?_⟩
  intro x hx y hy
  rw [ha x hx,hb y hy]
  exact hab

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.axis_phase_ordered
statement:
theorem axis_phase_ordered (column : Bool) (h : Nat) :
    (axis column h).Pairwise (fun x y => phase column x ≤ phase column y)
proof:
:= by
  have ha : ∀ x ∈ anchors h, phase column x = 0 := by
    intro x hx
    simp only [anchors,List.mem_map] at hx
    rcases hx with ⟨i,hi,rfl⟩
    rfl
  have hd : ∀ x ∈ dummies h, phase column x = (if column then 1 else 2) := by
    intro x hx
    simp only [dummies,List.mem_map] at hx
    rcases hx with ⟨i,hi,rfl⟩
    rfl
  have ht : ∀ x ∈ tree column h 0 0, phase column x = (if column then 2 else 1) := by
    intro x hx
    have hv := tree_variable column h 0 0 x hx
    cases x <;> simp_all [phase,IsVariable]
  have hn : (nonanchors column h).Pairwise (fun x y => phase column x ≤ phase column y) := by
    cases column
    · exact phase_pairwise_append false _ _ 1 2 ht hd (by decide)
    · exact phase_pairwise_append true _ _ 1 2 hd ht (by decide)
  apply List.pairwise_append.mpr
  refine ⟨constant_phase_pairwise column _ 0 ha,hn,?_⟩
  intro x hx y hy
  rw [ha x hx]
  exact Nat.zero_le _

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.index_lt_of_phase_lt
statement:
private theorem index_lt_of_phase_lt (column : Bool) (h : Nat) (x y : Fin (size h))
    (hp : phase column (labelAt column h x) < phase column (labelAt column h y)) : x.val < y.val
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hlt : x.val < y.val
  · exact hlt
  · by_cases he : x = y
    · subst y; omega
    · have hrev : y.val < x.val := by omega
      have hx : x.val < (axis column h).length := by rw [axis_length]; exact x.isLt
      have hy : y.val < (axis column h).length := by rw [axis_length]; exact y.isLt
      have ho := (axis_phase_ordered column h).rel_getElem_of_lt hy hx hrev
      change phase column (labelAt column h y) ≤ phase column (labelAt column h x) at ho
      omega

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.variable_before_row_dummy
statement:
theorem variable_before_row_dummy (h i p a b : Nat) (s : Bool) (x y : Fin (size h))
    (hx : labelAt false h x = .variable i s p a) (hy : labelAt false h y = .dummy b) :
    x.val < y.val
proof:
:= by
  apply index_lt_of_phase_lt false h x y
  simp [hx,hy,phase]

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.column_dummy_before_variable
statement:
theorem column_dummy_before_variable (h i p a b : Nat) (s : Bool) (x y : Fin (size h))
    (hx : labelAt true h x = .dummy a) (hy : labelAt true h y = .variable i s p b) :
    x.val < y.val
proof:
:= by
  apply index_lt_of_phase_lt true h x y
  simp [hx,hy,phase]

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.same_class_variable
statement:
private theorem same_class_variable (r c : Position) (hr : IsVariable r)
    (hclass : SameClass r c) : IsVariable c
proof:
:= by
  cases r <;> cases c <;> simp_all [IsVariable, SameClass]

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.unpinned_copy_localization
statement:
theorem unpinned_copy_localization (h : Nat) (rows cols : Fin 4 → Fin (size h))
    (hc : Copy h rows cols) (hn1 : Nonanchor (labelAt true h (cols 1))) :
    sparseZero h (rows 2) (cols 3)
proof:
:= by
  have hs := copy_anchor_shape h rows cols hc
  rcases anchor_exists _ hs.1 with ⟨l0,k0,g0,a0,hr0⟩
  rcases anchor_exists _ hs.2.1 with ⟨l,k,g,a1,hr1⟩
  rcases anchor_exists _ hs.2.2.2.2.1 with ⟨j0,t0,z0,b0,hc0⟩
  rcases second_row_first_column_groups h rows cols hc l k g a1 j0 t0 z0 b0 hr1 hc0 with
    ⟨hlj,hkt,hg,hz⟩
  subst j0
  subst t0
  subst g
  subst z0
  have hv0 := anchor_index_valid false h (rows 0) l0 k0 g0 a0 hr0
  have hv1 := anchor_index_valid false h (rows 1) l k 1 a1 hr1
  have hlh := anchor_index_level_bound false h (rows 1) l k 1 a1 hr1
  have hvar := zero_nonanchors_variable h _ _ hs.2.2.1 hs.2.2.2.2.2.2
    (hc.2.2 2 3)
  rcases variable_data_exists _ hvar.1 with ⟨⟨i,s,p,a⟩,hr⟩
  rcases variable_data_exists _ hvar.2 with ⟨⟨j,t,b,w⟩,hlast⟩
  change .variable i s p a = labelAt false h (rows 2) at hr
  change .variable j t b w = labelAt true h (cols 3) at hlast
  have hclass := anchor_row_connects h (rows 0) (cols 1) (cols 2) hs.1 hn1
    hs.2.2.2.2.2.1 (hc.2.2 0 1) (hc.2.2 0 2)
  have hvar1 := (zero_nonanchors_variable h _ _ hs.2.2.1 hn1 (hc.2.2 2 1)).2
  rcases variable_data_exists _ (same_class_variable _ _ hvar1 hclass) with
    ⟨⟨d,u,q,z⟩,hmiddle⟩
  change .variable d u q z = labelAt true h (cols 2) at hmiddle
  have hdiff : d ≠ j ∨ u ≠ t := by
    by_cases hd : d = j
    · by_cases hu : u = t
      · subst d
        subst u
        have hqb := same_class_node_order true h j q b z w t (cols 2) (cols 3)
          (hc.2.1 2 3 (by decide)) hmiddle.symm hlast.symm
        have hone : entry h (labelAt false h (rows 2)) (.variable j t q z) = true := by
          simpa only [matrix, ← hmiddle] using (show matrix h (rows 2) (cols 2) = true from hc.2.2 2 2)
        have hbad := variable_column_nested h j t q b z w hqb _ hs.2.2.1 hone
        have hzero : entry h (labelAt false h (rows 2)) (.variable j t b w) = false := by
          simpa only [matrix, ← hlast] using (show matrix h (rows 2) (cols 3) = false from hc.2.2 2 3)
        rw [hzero] at hbad
        contradiction
      · exact Or.inr hu
    · exact Or.inl hd
  have vi : i ≤ h ∧ (i = h → s = true) := by
    have hv := labelAt_valid false h (rows 2)
    simpa only [← hr, Valid] using hv
  have vd : d ≤ h ∧ (d = h → u = true) := by
    have hv := labelAt_valid true h (cols 2)
    simpa only [← hmiddle, Valid] using hv
  have vj : j ≤ h ∧ (j = h → t = true) := by
    have hv := labelAt_valid true h (cols 3)
    simpa only [← hlast, Valid] using hv
  have rr : rowRole h l k 0 (.variable i s p a) := by
    have he : entry h (labelAt false h (rows 2)) (.anchor l k 0 b0) = true := by
      simpa only [matrix, hc0] using (show matrix h (rows 2) (cols 0) = true from hc.2.2 2 0)
    simpa only [← hr] using nonanchor_row_role_of_entry h l k 0 b0 _ hs.2.2.1 he
  have cc : columnRole h l k 1 (.variable j t b w) := by
    have he : entry h (.anchor l k 1 a1) (labelAt true h (cols 3)) = true := by
      simpa only [matrix, hr1] using (show matrix h (rows 1) (cols 3) = true from hc.2.2 1 3)
    simpa only [← hlast] using nonanchor_column_role_of_entry h l k 1 a1 _ hs.2.2.2.2.2.2 he
  have hinc : columnRole h l0 k0 g0 (.variable d u q z) := by
    have he : entry h (.anchor l0 k0 g0 a0) (labelAt true h (cols 2)) = true := by
      simpa only [matrix, hr0] using (show matrix h (rows 0) (cols 2) = true from hc.2.2 0 2)
    simpa only [← hmiddle] using nonanchor_column_role_of_entry h l0 k0 g0 a0 _ hs.2.2.2.2.2.1 he
  have co : TraversalOrdered true (.variable d u q z) (.variable j t b w) := by
    simpa only [← hmiddle, ← hlast] using
      indexed_traversal_ordered true h (cols 2) (cols 3) (hc.2.1 2 3 (by decide))
  have hone : entry h (.variable i s p a) (.variable d u q z) = true := by
    simpa only [matrix, ← hr, ← hmiddle] using (show matrix h (rows 2) (cols 2) = true from hc.2.2 2 2)
  have hzero : entry h (.variable i s p a) (.variable j t b w) = false := by
    simpa only [matrix, ← hr, ← hlast] using (show matrix h (rows 2) (cols 3) = false from hc.2.2 2 3)
  have hord := first_two_anchor_order_strict h rows cols hc l0 k0 g0 a0 l k 1 a1 hr0 hr1
  rcases unpinned_body_localizes h l k l0 k0 g0 b0 i p a d q z j b w s u t
    hv1.1 hlh hv1.2.1 hv0.1 hv0.2.1 hv0.2.2 vi vd vj rr cc hdiff co hone hzero hord hinc with
    ⟨hi,hsign,hj,ht,hb⟩
  subst i
  subst s
  subst j
  subst t
  subst b
  have hm : .variable h true p a ∈ axis false h := by rw [hr]; exact List.getElem_mem _
  have ha := leaf_tag_clone_zero false h true p a hm
  subst a
  exact ⟨p,w,hr.symm,hlast.symm⟩

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.all_copy_localization
statement:
theorem all_copy_localization (h : Nat) (_hh : 1 ≤ h)
    (rows cols : Fin 4 → Fin (size h)) (hc : Copy h rows cols) :
    sparseZero h (rows 2) (cols 3)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ha : Anchor (labelAt true h (cols 1))
  · exact canonical_copy_localization h rows cols hc ha
  · have hn : Nonanchor (labelAt true h (cols 1)) := by
      cases he : labelAt true h (cols 1) <;> simp_all [Anchor, Nonanchor]
    exact unpinned_copy_localization h rows cols hc hn

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.block_length
statement:
@[simp] theorem block_length (depth : Nat) (plus : Bool) (node size : Nat) :
    (block depth plus node size).length = size
proof: := by simp [block]

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.tree_length
statement:
theorem tree_length (column : Bool) (rem depth node : Nat) :
    (tree column rem depth node).length = (2 * rem + 1) * 2 ^ rem
proof:
:= by
  induction rem generalizing depth node with
  | zero => simp [tree]
  | succ rem ih =>
    simp only [tree, List.length_append, block_length, ih, Nat.pow_succ]
    simp only [Nat.add_mul, Nat.mul_add]
    simp only [Nat.mul_assoc]
    simp only [← Nat.mul_assoc rem (2 ^ rem) 2]
    omega

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.anchors_length
statement: theorem anchors_length (h : Nat) : (anchors h).length = 12 * h * 2 ^ h
proof:
:= by
  simp [anchors]

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.axis_length
statement: theorem axis_length (column : Bool) (h : Nat) : (axis column h).length = size h
proof:
:= by
  cases column <;>
    simp only [axis, nonanchors, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, List.length_append, anchors_length,
      dummies, List.length_map, List.length_range, tree_length, size]
  all_goals simp only [Nat.add_mul, Nat.mul_assoc]
  all_goals omega

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.labelAt_append
statement:
theorem labelAt_append (column : Bool) (h : Nat) (j : Fin (size h)) :
    labelAt column h j = (anchors h ++ nonanchors column h)[j.val]'(by
      change j.val < (axis column h).length
      rw [axis_length]; exact j.isLt)
proof: := rfl

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.leaf_sign_identification
statement:
@[simp] theorem leaf_sign_identification (h p a : Nat) :
    signedPosition h h false p a = signedPosition h h true p a
proof:
:= by
  simp [signedPosition]

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.labelAt_surjective
statement:
theorem labelAt_surjective (column : Bool) (h : Nat) (p : Position)
    (hp : p ∈ axis column h) : ∃ j : Fin (size h), labelAt column h j = p
proof:
:= by
  rcases List.mem_iff_getElem.mp hp with ⟨j, hj, he⟩
  have hj' : j < size h := by rw [← axis_length column h]; exact hj
  exact ⟨⟨j, hj'⟩, he⟩

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.tagCopy_of_copy
statement:
theorem tagCopy_of_copy (h : Nat) (rows cols : Fin 4 → Fin (size h))
    (hc : Copy h rows cols) :
    TagCopy h (fun i => labelAt false h (rows i)) (fun i => labelAt true h (cols i))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, hc.2.2⟩
  · intro i; exact List.getElem_mem _
  · intro i; exact List.getElem_mem _
  · intro i j hij; exact ⟨rows i, rows j, rfl, rfl, hc.1 i j hij⟩
  · intro i j hij; exact ⟨cols i, cols j, rfl, rfl, hc.2.1 i j hij⟩

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.tagCopy_iff_exists_copy
statement:
theorem tagCopy_iff_exists_copy (h : Nat) (rr cc : Fin 4 → Position) :
    TagCopy h rr cc ↔ ∃ rows cols : Fin 4 → Fin (size h),
      Copy h rows cols ∧ (∀ i, labelAt false h (rows i) = rr i) ∧
      (∀ i, labelAt true h (cols i) = cc i)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro ht
    have hr : ∀ i, ∃ j, labelAt false h j = rr i := fun i => labelAt_surjective false h _ (ht.1 i)
    have hc : ∀ i, ∃ j, labelAt true h j = cc i := fun i => labelAt_surjective true h _ (ht.2.1 i)
    let rows := fun i => Classical.choose (hr i)
    let cols := fun i => Classical.choose (hc i)
    have her : ∀ i, labelAt false h (rows i) = rr i := fun i => Classical.choose_spec (hr i)
    have hec : ∀ i, labelAt true h (cols i) = cc i := fun i => Classical.choose_spec (hc i)
    refine ⟨rows, cols, ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩, her, hec⟩
    · intro i j hij
      rcases ht.2.2.1 i j hij with ⟨x, y, hx, hy, hxy⟩
      have hxi := labelAt_injective false h x (rows i) (hx.trans (her i).symm)
      have hyj := labelAt_injective false h y (rows j) (hy.trans (her j).symm)
      simpa [hxi, hyj] using hxy
    · intro i j hij
      rcases ht.2.2.2.1 i j hij with ⟨x, y, hx, hy, hxy⟩
      have hxi := labelAt_injective true h x (cols i) (hx.trans (hec i).symm)
      have hyj := labelAt_injective true h y (cols j) (hy.trans (hec j).symm)
      simpa [hxi, hyj] using hxy
    · intro i j
      simp only [matrix, her, hec]
      exact ht.2.2.2.2 i j
  · rintro ⟨rows, cols, hc, hr, he⟩
    have ht := tagCopy_of_copy h rows cols hc
    have er : (fun i => labelAt false h (rows i)) = rr := funext hr
    have ec : (fun i => labelAt true h (cols i)) = cc := funext he
    rw [er, ec] at ht
    exact ht

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.first_two_anchor_order_strict
statement:
theorem first_two_anchor_order_strict (h : Nat)
    (rows cols : Fin 4 → Fin (size h)) (hc : Copy h rows cols)
    (l k g a l' k' g' a' : Nat)
    (h0 : labelAt false h (rows 0) = .anchor l k g a)
    (h1 : labelAt false h (rows 1) = .anchor l' k' g' a') :
    anchorRank (l - 1) k g < anchorRank (l' - 1) k' g'
proof:
:= by
  have hv0 := anchor_index_valid false h (rows 0) l k g a h0
  have hv1 := anchor_index_valid false h (rows 1) l' k' g' a' h1
  have hord := anchor_order_le false h (rows 0) (rows 1) l k g a l' k' g' a'
    h0 h1 (hc.1 0 1 (by decide))
  by_cases heq : anchorRank (l - 1) k g = anchorRank (l' - 1) k' g'
  · have hsame : l = l' ∧ k = k' ∧ g = g' := by
      unfold anchorRank at heq
      omega
    rcases hsame with ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
    have hm0 := hc.2.2 0 0
    have hm1 := hc.2.2 1 0
    simp only [matrix, h0, h1] at hm0 hm1
    rw [anchor_row_twins (b := a')] at hm0
    rw [hm1] at hm0
    contradiction
  · omega

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.no_even_minus_nonterminal_shape
statement:
theorem no_even_minus_nonterminal_shape (h i l k g a a' p q b x z w : Nat)
    (rows cols : Fin 4 → Fin (size h)) (hc : Copy h rows cols)
    (hi : i < h) (hpos : 1 ≤ i)
    (hr0 : labelAt false h (rows 0) = .anchor l k g a)
    (hr1 : labelAt false h (rows 1) = .anchor i 4 1 a')
    (hr2 : labelAt false h (rows 2) = .variable i false p x)
    (hc2 : labelAt true h (cols 2) = .variable i false q z)
    (hc3 : labelAt true h (cols 3) = .variable (i - 1) false b w) : False
proof:
:= by
  have hparent := column_minus_child_parent h i q b z w (cols 2) (cols 3)
    hpos (hc.2.1 2 3 (by decide)) hc2 hc3
  have hl := (anchor_index_valid false h (rows 0) l k g a hr0).1
  have hord := first_two_anchor_order_strict h rows cols hc l k g a i 4 1 a' hr0 hr1
  have hone := hc.2.2 2 2
  simp [matrix, hr2, hc2, entry, H4, signed, Nat.ne_of_lt hi] at hone
  have hzero := hc.2.2 2 3
  have hd : i ≠ i - 1 := by omega
  have hs : i = i - 1 + 1 := by omega
  simp [matrix, hr2, hc3, entry, H4, signed, Nat.ne_of_lt hi, hd] at hzero
  have hinc := hc.2.2 0 2
  simp only [matrix, hr0, hc2] at hinc
  exact nonterminal_sibling_exception_impossible h i l k g p q b a z
    hi hpos hl hord hinc hone.2 (by omega) (by omega)

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.no_nonterminal_unpinned_minus_shape
statement:
theorem no_nonterminal_unpinned_minus_shape
    (h i t l k g a a' c p q b x z w : Nat)
    (rows cols : Fin 4 → Fin (size h)) (hc : Copy h rows cols)
    (hi : i < h) (hpos : 1 ≤ i) (ht : t = 4 ∨ t = 5)
    (hr0 : labelAt false h (rows 0) = .anchor l k g a)
    (hr1 : labelAt false h (rows 1) = .anchor i t 1 a')
    (hr2 : labelAt false h (rows 2) = .variable i false p x)
    (hc0 : labelAt true h (cols 0) = .anchor i t 0 c)
    (hc2 : labelAt true h (cols 2) = .variable i false q z)
    (hc3 : labelAt true h (cols 3) = .variable (i - 1) false b w) : False
proof:
:= by
  have hparent := column_minus_child_parent h i q b z w (cols 2) (cols 3)
    hpos (hc.2.1 2 3 (by decide)) hc2 hc3
  have hone := hc.2.2 2 2
  simp [matrix, hr2, hc2, entry, H4, signed, Nat.ne_of_lt hi] at hone
  have hzero := hc.2.2 2 3
  have hd : i ≠ i - 1 := by omega
  have hs : i = i - 1 + 1 := by omega
  simp [matrix, hr2, hc3, entry, H4, signed, Nat.ne_of_lt hi, hd] at hzero
  have hsib := OrderedMatrixRemoval4.nonterminal_siblings p q b hone.2 hparent (by omega)
  have hpar := hc.2.2 2 0
  simp [matrix, hr2, hc0, entry, H4, rowRole, signed, Nat.ne_of_lt hi] at hpar
  have ht4 : t = 4 := by omega
  subst t
  exact no_even_minus_nonterminal_shape h i l k g a a' p q b x z w rows cols hc
    hi hpos hr0 hr1 hr2 hc2 hc3

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.selected_row
statement:
private theorem selected_row {h : Nat} (s : PathSelection h) (i : Nat) (hi : i ≤ h) (sig : Bool) :
    s.Selected false (s.row i sig)
proof: := Or.inl ⟨i,hi,sig,rfl⟩

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.selected_col
statement:

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.four_selected
statement:
private theorem four_selected {h : Nat} (s : PathSelection h) (column : Bool)

    (hc : s.Selected column c) (hd : s.Selected column d) :

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.intact_mode_guard
statement:
theorem intact_mode_guard (h i k : Nat) (B : BinaryMatrix (size h)) (s : PathSelection h)
    (hi : i < h) (hk : k < 6) (hint : IntactPath h B s)
    (r2 r3 c2 c3 : Fin (size h))
    (sr2 : s.Selected false r2) (sr3 : s.Selected false r3)
    (sc2 : s.Selected true c2) (sc3 : s.Selected true c3)
    (hg : FrameGuard (matrix h)
      (four (s.ra (i+1) k 0) (s.ra (i+1) k 1) r2 r3)
      (four (s.ca (i+1) k 0) (s.ca (i+1) k 1) c2 c3)) :
    FrameGuard B
      (four (s.ra (i+1) k 0) (s.ra (i+1) k 1) r2 r3)
      (four (s.ca (i+1) k 0) (s.ca (i+1) k 1) c2 c3)
proof:
:= by
  have hr := four_selected s false _ _ _ _
    (selected_ra s (i+1) k 0 (by omega) (by omega) hk (by decide))
    (selected_ra s (i+1) k 1 (by omega) (by omega) hk (by decide)) sr2 sr3
  have hc := four_selected s true _ _ _ _
    (selected_ca s (i+1) k 0 (by omega) (by omega) hk (by decide))
    (selected_ca s (i+1) k 1 (by omega) (by omega) hk (by decide)) sc2 sc3
  refine ⟨hg.1,hg.2.1,?_⟩
  intro a b hab
  have hp : Protected h
      (four (s.ra (i+1) k 0) (s.ra (i+1) k 1) r2 r3 a)
      (four (s.ca (i+1) k 0) (s.ca (i+1) k 1) c2 c3 b) := by
    rcases hab with ha | hb
    · have he : a = 0 ∨ a = 1 := by omega
      rcases he with rfl | rfl
      all_goals apply Or.inl
      · simp [four,Anchor,s.raLabel (i+1) (by omega) (by omega) k hk 0 (by decide)]
      · simp [four,Anchor,s.raLabel (i+1) (by omega) (by omega) k hk 1 (by decide)]
    · have he : b = 0 ∨ b = 1 := by omega
      rcases he with rfl | rfl
      all_goals apply Or.inr ∘ Or.inl
      · simp [four,Anchor,s.caLabel (i+1) (by omega) (by omega) k hk 0 (by decide)]
      · simp [four,Anchor,s.caLabel (i+1) (by omega) (by omega) k hk 1 (by decide)]
  exact (hint _ _ (hr a) (hc b) hp).trans (hg.2.2 a b hab)

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.intact_dummy_column
statement:
theorem intact_dummy_column (h i : Nat) (B : BinaryMatrix (size h)) (s : PathSelection h)
    (hi : i ≤ h) (sig : Bool) (hint : IntactPath h B s) : B (s.row i sig) s.cd = true
proof:

statement:

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.intact_roots
statement:
theorem intact_roots (h : Nat) (hh : 1 ≤ h) (B : BinaryMatrix (size h))
    (s : PathSelection h) (hint : IntactPath h B s) :
    B (s.row 0 true) (s.col 0 true) = true ∧ B (s.row 0 false) (s.col 0 false) = false
proof:
:= by
  have hp : ∀ sig, Protected h (s.row 0 sig) (s.col 0 sig) := by
    intro sig
    apply Or.inr ∘ Or.inr ∘ Or.inr ∘ Or.inr
    simp [s.rowLabel 0 (by omega) sig,s.colLabel 0 (by omega) sig,Root]
  have hb := fun sig => hint _ _ (selected_row s 0 (by omega) sig) (selected_col s 0 (by omega) sig) (hp sig)
  have hz : 0 ≠ h := by omega
  constructor
  · rw [hb true]
    simp [matrix,s.rowLabel 0 (by omega) true,s.colLabel 0 (by omega) true,
      viewSign,hz,entry,signed,s.root]
  · rw [hb false]
    simp [matrix,s.rowLabel 0 (by omega) false,s.colLabel 0 (by omega) false,
      viewSign,hz,entry,signed,s.root]

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.path_shared_leaf
statement:
theorem path_shared_leaf (h : Nat) (s : PathSelection h) :
    s.row h true = s.row h false ∧ s.col h true = s.col h false
proof:
:= by
  have hr := fun sig => s.rowLabel h (Nat.le_refl h) sig
  have hc := fun sig => s.colLabel h (Nat.le_refl h) sig
  have hrc : ∀ sig, s.rowClone h sig = 0 := by
    intro sig
    apply leaf_tag_clone_zero false h true (s.node h) (s.rowClone h sig)
    have hm := List.getElem_mem (labelAt._proof_1 false h (s.row h sig))
    change labelAt false h (s.row h sig) ∈ axis false h at hm
    simpa [hr sig,viewSign] using hm
  have hcc : ∀ sig, s.colClone h sig = 0 := by
    intro sig
    apply leaf_tag_clone_zero true h true (s.node h) (s.colClone h sig)
    have hm := List.getElem_mem (labelAt._proof_1 true h (s.col h sig))
    change labelAt true h (s.col h sig) ∈ axis true h at hm
    simpa [hc sig,viewSign] using hm
  constructor
  · apply labelAt_injective false h
    simp [hr,hrc,viewSign]
  · apply labelAt_injective true h
    simp [hc,hcc,viewSign]

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.intact_path_contains_copy
statement:
theorem intact_path_contains_copy (h : Nat) (hh : 1 ≤ h) (B : BinaryMatrix (size h))
    (s : PathSelection h) (hint : IntactPath h B s) :
    ∃ rows cols, OrderedCopy H4 B rows cols
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply Classical.byContradiction
  intro hn
  have hf : HFree H4 B := fun rows cols hc => hn ⟨rows,cols,hc⟩
  let vpr := fun i => four (s.ra (i+1) 0 0) (s.ra (i+1) 0 1) (s.row (i+1) true) (s.row i true)
  let vpc := fun i => four (s.ca (i+1) 0 0) (s.ca (i+1) 0 1) s.cd (s.col i true)
  let vmr := fun i => four (s.ra (i+1) 1 0) (s.ra (i+1) 1 1) (s.row i false) (s.row (i+1) false)
  let vmc := fun i => four (s.ca (i+1) 1 0) (s.ca (i+1) 1 1) s.cd (s.col i false)
  let wpr := fun i => let k := 2 + s.node (i+1) % 2
    four (s.ra (i+1) k 0) (s.ra (i+1) k 1) (s.row (i+1) true) s.rd
  let wpc := fun i => let k := 2 + s.node (i+1) % 2
    four (s.ca (i+1) k 0) (s.ca (i+1) k 1) (s.col i true) (s.col (i+1) true)
  let wmr := fun i => let k := 4 + s.node (i+1) % 2
    four (s.ra (i+1) k 0) (s.ra (i+1) k 1) (s.row (i+1) false) s.rd
  let wmc := fun i => let k := 4 + s.node (i+1) % 2
    four (s.ca (i+1) k 0) (s.ca (i+1) k 1) (s.col (i+1) false) (s.col i false)
  have hroots := intact_roots h hh B s hint
  have hleaf : B (s.row h true) (s.col h true) = B (s.row h false) (s.col h false) := by
    rw [(path_shared_leaf h s).1,(path_shared_leaf h s).2]
  apply guarded_path_contradiction B h hf
    (fun i => B (s.row i true) (s.col i true))
    (fun i => B (s.row i false) (s.col i false))
    (fun i => B (s.row (i+1) true) (s.col i true))
    (fun i => B (s.row (i+1) false) (s.col i false))
    vpr vpc vmr vmc wpr wpc wmr wmc hroots.1 hroots.2 hleaf
  · intro i hi
    refine ⟨?_,?_,?_,?_⟩
    · exact intact_mode_guard h i 0 B s hi (by decide) hint _ _ _ _
        (selected_row s _ (by omega) true) (selected_row s _ (by omega) true)
        (selected_cd s) (selected_col s _ (by omega) true) (path_vertical_plus_guard h i s hi)
    · exact intact_mode_guard h i 1 B s hi (by decide) hint _ _ _ _
        (selected_row s _ (by omega) false) (selected_row s _ (by omega) false)
        (selected_cd s) (selected_col s _ (by omega) false) (path_vertical_minus_guard h i s hi)
    · exact intact_mode_guard h i (2+s.node (i+1)%2) B s hi (by omega) hint _ _ _ _
        (selected_row s _ (by omega) true) (selected_rd s)
        (selected_col s _ (by omega) true) (selected_col s _ (by omega) true)
        (path_horizontal_plus_guard h i s hi)
    · exact intact_mode_guard h i (4+s.node (i+1)%2) B s hi (by omega) hint _ _ _ _
        (selected_row s _ (by omega) false) (selected_rd s)
        (selected_col s _ (by omega) false) (selected_col s _ (by omega) false)
        (path_horizontal_minus_guard h i s hi)
  · intro i hi
    have hdc0 := intact_dummy_column h i B s (by omega) true hint
    have hdc1 := intact_dummy_column h (i+1) B s (by omega) true hint
    have hdm0 := intact_dummy_column h i B s (by omega) false hint
    have hdm1 := intact_dummy_column h (i+1) B s (by omega) false hint
    have hdr0 := intact_dummy_row h i B s (by omega) true hint
    have hdr1 := intact_dummy_row h (i+1) B s (by omega) true hint
    have hdrm0 := intact_dummy_row h i B s (by omega) false hint
    have hdrm1 := intact_dummy_row h (i+1) B s (by omega) false hint
    simp [BodyBits,vpr,vpc,vmr,vmc,wpr,wpc,wmr,wmc,four,
      hdc0,hdc1,hdm0,hdm1,hdr0,hdr1,hdrm0,hdrm1]

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.add_mod_cancel_bounded
statement:
private theorem add_mod_cancel_bounded (m u v w : Nat) (hu : u < m) (hv : v < m) (hw : w < m)
    (he : (u + v) % m = (u + w) % m) : v = w
proof:
:= by
  have hmv := Nat.mod_add_div (u+v) m
  have hmw := Nat.mod_add_div (u+w) m
  have hdv : (u+v)/m ≤ 1 := by
    apply Nat.le_of_lt_succ
    exact (Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul (by omega : 0 < m)).mpr (by omega)
  have hdw : (u+w)/m ≤ 1 := by
    apply Nat.le_of_lt_succ
    exact (Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul (by omega : 0 < m)).mpr (by omega)
  have hcasesv : (u+v)/m = 0 ∨ (u+v)/m = 1 := Nat.le_one_iff_eq_zero_or_eq_one.mp hdv
  have hcasesw : (u+w)/m = 0 ∨ (u+w)/m = 1 := Nat.le_one_iff_eq_zero_or_eq_one.mp hdw
  rcases hcasesv with hdv | hdv <;> rcases hcasesw with hdw | hdw
  all_goals rw [hdv] at hmv
  all_goals rw [hdw] at hmw
  all_goals simp only [Nat.mul_zero,Nat.mul_one] at hmv hmw
  all_goals omega

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.shift_class_injective
statement:
theorem shift_class_injective (m d u v w : Nat) (hd : d ∣ m)
    (hu : u < m) (hv : v < m) (hw : w < m)
    (hnode : ((u+v)%m)/d = ((u+w)%m)/d) (hclone : v%d = w%d) : v = w
proof:
:= by
  have hrem : ((u+v)%m)%d = ((u+w)%m)%d := by
    rw [Nat.mod_mod_of_dvd _ hd,Nat.mod_mod_of_dvd _ hd,
      Nat.add_mod u v d,Nat.add_mod u w d,hclone]
  have hvd := Nat.mod_add_div ((u+v)%m) d
  have hwd := Nat.mod_add_div ((u+w)%m) d
  have he : (u+v)%m = (u+w)%m := by rw [hrem,hnode] at hvd; omega
  exact add_mod_cancel_bounded m u v w hu hv hw he

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.dyadic_split
statement: theorem dyadic_split (h i : Nat) (hi : i ≤ h) : 2 ^ h = 2 ^ i * 2 ^ (h-i)
proof:
:= by
  have he : h = i + (h-i) := by omega
  calc
    2 ^ h = 2 ^ (i+(h-i)) := congrArg (fun e => 2 ^ e) he
    _ = 2 ^ i * 2 ^ (h-i) := Nat.pow_add ..

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.same_class_rows_no_cross

    (h01 : entry h r d = false) (h11 : entry h s d = true) : False

      rcases Nat.le_total p q with hle | hle
      · have hn := variable_row_nested h i sig p q a b hle d hd h11
        rw [h01] at hn

  rcases he with he | he | he

  · exact Or.inr (Or.inl (same_class_parity_row_signature h r t hrt he))

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.canonical_body_localizes
statement:
theorem canonical_body_localizes (h l k : Nat) (r0 r1 c0 c1 : Position)
    (hl : 1 ≤ l) (hlh : l ≤ h) (hk : k < 6)
    (vr0 : Valid h r0) (vr1 : Valid h r1) (vc0 : Valid h c0) (vc1 : Valid h c1)
    (nr0 : Nonanchor r0) (nr1 : Nonanchor r1) (nc0 : Nonanchor c0) (nc1 : Nonanchor c1)
    (rr0 : rowRole h l k 0 r0) (rr1 : rowRole h l k 1 r1)
    (cc0 : columnRole h l k 0 c0) (cc1 : columnRole h l k 1 c1)
    (ro : TraversalOrdered false r0 r1) (co : TraversalOrdered true c0 c1)

statement:
theorem exponential_choice (c C : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (_hC : 0 < C) (L : Nat) :

    htend.eventually (gt_mem_nhds hc)

  have hd : (1:ℝ) ≤ 14*(h:ℝ)+2 := by nlinarith

    calc
      _ ≤ (14*(h:ℝ)+2)^K := by
        rw [← Real.rpow_natCast]
        exact Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hd hK
      _ ≤ (16*(h:ℝ))^K := pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) (by nlinarith) K
      _ = _ := by rw [mul_pow]
  have hm : (0:ℝ) < 2^h := by positivity
  have hdpos : (0:ℝ) < 14*(h:ℝ)+2 := by positivity
  have hp : 0 < (14*(h:ℝ)+2)^(2*C) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hdpos _
  have heps : (epsilon h)^C = ((14*(h:ℝ)+2)^(2*C))⁻¹ := by
    unfold epsilon
    rw [one_div,Real.inv_rpow (by positivity),← Real.rpow_natCast,← Real.rpow_mul (by positivity)]
    norm_num
  rw [heps]
  apply (lt_mul_inv_iff₀ hp).mpr
  have hbound : 2 * (14*(h:ℝ)+2)^(2*C) / 2^h < c := by
    calc
      _ ≤ (2*16^K:ℝ)*((h:ℝ)^K/2^h) := by
        apply (div_le_iff₀ hm).mpr
        field_simp
        nlinarith
      _ < c := hh
  have hd2 : 1 ≤ (14*(h:ℝ)+2)^2 := by nlinarith
  calc
    _ = (2 * (14*(h:ℝ)+2)^(2*C) / 2^h) / (14*(h:ℝ)+2)^2 := by
      field_simp
    _ ≤ 2 * (14*(h:ℝ)+2)^(2*C) / 2^h :=
      div_le_self (by positivity) hd2
    _ < c := hbound

  have hnpos : (0:ℝ) < (Host.size h*t:Nat) := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < Host.size h*t by omega)

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.tree_terminal_clone
statement:
theorem tree_terminal_clone (column : Bool) (rem depth node j : Nat) (s : Bool) (q a : Nat)
    (hm : .variable j s q a ∈ tree column rem depth node)
    (hj : j = depth + rem) : a = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction rem generalizing depth node with
  | zero =>
    have he := List.eq_of_mem_singleton hm
    cases he
    rfl
  | succ rem ih =>
    simp only [tree, List.mem_append] at hm
    rcases hm with ((hm | hm) | hm) | hm
    · simp only [block, List.mem_map] at hm
      rcases hm with ⟨a', _, he⟩
      have hd := (Position.variable.inj he).1
      omega
    · exact ih _ _ hm (by omega)
    · exact ih _ _ hm (by omega)
    · simp only [block, List.mem_map] at hm
      rcases hm with ⟨a', _, he⟩
      have hd := (Position.variable.inj he).1
      omega

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.leaf_tag_clone_zero
statement:
theorem leaf_tag_clone_zero (column : Bool) (h : Nat) (s : Bool) (q a : Nat)
    (hm : .variable h s q a ∈ axis column h) : a = 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases List.mem_append.mp hm with hm | hm
  · simp only [anchors, List.mem_map] at hm
    rcases hm with ⟨index, _, he⟩
    unfold anchorLabel at he
    contradiction
  · unfold nonanchors at hm
    cases column <;> simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, List.mem_append] at hm
    · rcases hm with ht | hd
      · exact tree_terminal_clone false h 0 0 h s q a ht (by omega)
      · simp only [dummies, List.mem_map] at hd
        rcases hd with ⟨_, _, he⟩; contradiction
    · rcases hm with hd | ht
      · simp only [dummies, List.mem_map] at hd
        rcases hd with ⟨_, _, he⟩; contradiction
      · exact tree_terminal_clone true h 0 0 h s q a ht (by omega)

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.anchor_index_level_bound
statement:
theorem anchor_index_level_bound (column : Bool) (h : Nat) (x : Fin (size h))
    (l k g a : Nat) (hx : labelAt column h x = .anchor l k g a) : l ≤ h
proof:
:= by
  have hv := anchor_index_valid column h x l k g a hx
  have hi := anchor_index_lt column h x l k g a hx
  rw [anchors_length] at hi
  have hq : x.val / 2 ^ h < 12 * h :=
    (Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul (Nat.pow_pos (by decide : 0 < 2))).mpr hi
  have ho := anchor_index_ordinal column h x l k g a hx
  unfold anchorRank at ho
  omega

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.canonical_frame_of_copy
statement:
theorem canonical_frame_of_copy (h : Nat) (rows cols : Fin 4 → Fin (size h))
    (hc : Copy h rows cols) (hc1 : Anchor (labelAt true h (cols 1))) : CanonicalFrame h rows cols
proof:
:= by
  have hshape := copy_anchor_shape h rows cols hc
  rcases anchor_exists _ hshape.1 with ⟨u,v,w,a0,hr0⟩
  rcases anchor_exists _ hshape.2.1 with ⟨l,k,g,a1,hr1⟩
  rcases anchor_exists _ hshape.2.2.2.2.1 with ⟨j,t,z,b0,hc0⟩
  rcases anchor_exists _ hc1 with ⟨j',t',z',b1,hc1'⟩
  have hgroups := second_row_first_column_groups h rows cols hc l k g a1 j t z b0 hr1 hc0
  rcases hgroups with ⟨hlj,hkt,hg,hz⟩
  subst j
  subst t
  subst g
  subst z
  have hv0 := anchor_index_valid false h (rows 0) u v w a0 hr0
  have hvc := anchor_index_valid true h (cols 1) j' t' z' b1 hc1'
  have hrord := first_two_anchor_order_strict h rows cols hc u v w a0 l k 1 a1 hr0 hr1
  have hcord := anchor_order_le true h (cols 0) (cols 1) l k 0 b0 j' t' z' b1
    hc0 hc1' (hc.2.1 0 1 (by decide))
  have hbit : matrix h (rows 0) (cols 1) = true := hc.2.2 0 1
  simp only [matrix, hr0, hc1', entry, decide_eq_true_eq] at hbit
  have hvl := anchor_index_valid false h (rows 1) l k 1 a1 hr1
  have heq : u = l ∧ v = k ∧ w = 0 ∧ j' = l ∧ t' = k ∧ z' = 1 := by
    unfold anchorRank at hrord hcord
    omega
  rcases heq with ⟨hu,hv,hw,hj,ht,hz⟩
  subst u
  subst v
  subst w
  subst j'
  subst t'
  subst z'
  refine ⟨l,k,a0,a1,b0,b1,hvl.1,anchor_index_level_bound false h (rows 1) l k 1 a1 hr1,
    hvl.2.1,hr0,hr1,hc0,hc1',?_,?_,?_,?_⟩
  · have he : entry h (labelAt false h (rows 2)) (.anchor l k 0 b0) = true := by
      simpa only [matrix, hc0] using (show matrix h (rows 2) (cols 0) = true from hc.2.2 2 0)
    exact nonanchor_row_role_of_entry h l k 0 b0 _ hshape.2.2.1 he
  · have he : entry h (labelAt false h (rows 3)) (.anchor l k 1 b1) = true := by
      simpa only [matrix, hc1'] using (show matrix h (rows 3) (cols 1) = true from hc.2.2 3 1)
    exact nonanchor_row_role_of_entry h l k 1 b1 _ hshape.2.2.2.1 he
  · have he : entry h (.anchor l k 0 a0) (labelAt true h (cols 2)) = true := by
      simpa only [matrix, hr0] using (show matrix h (rows 0) (cols 2) = true from hc.2.2 0 2)
    exact nonanchor_column_role_of_entry h l k 0 a0 _ hshape.2.2.2.2.2.1 he
  · have he : entry h (.anchor l k 1 a1) (labelAt true h (cols 3)) = true := by
      simpa only [matrix, hr1] using (show matrix h (rows 1) (cols 3) = true from hc.2.2 1 3)
    exact nonanchor_column_role_of_entry h l k 1 a1 _ hshape.2.2.2.2.2.2 he

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.TerminalAnchorRepair.anchor_agreement
statement:
theorem anchor_agreement (h : Nat) (r c : Fin (size h))
    (hr : Anchor (labelAt false h r)) : matrix h r c = Host.matrix h r c

:= by

  simp [matrix,hn]

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.TerminalAnchorRepair.outside_agreement
statement:

    (hc : ¬ TerminalColumn h (labelAt true h c)) :

statement:
