name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.TerminalAnchorRepair.third_row_nonanchor_of_anchor_agreement
statement:
theorem third_row_nonanchor_of_anchor_agreement (h : Nat)
    (B : BinaryMatrix (size h))
    (hag : ∀ r c, Anchor (labelAt false h r) → B r c = Host.matrix h r c)
    (rows cols : Fin 4 → Fin (size h)) (hc : OrderedCopy H4 B rows cols) :
    Nonanchor (labelAt false h (rows 2))
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hr2 : Anchor (labelAt false h (rows 2))
  · have hi2 := (anchor_iff_index_lt false h (rows 2)).mp hr2
    have hr0 : Anchor (labelAt false h (rows 0)) :=
      anchor_of_index_lt false h (rows 0) (by have ho := hc.1 0 2 (by decide); omega)
    have hr1 : Anchor (labelAt false h (rows 1)) :=
      anchor_of_index_lt false h (rows 1) (by have ho := hc.1 1 2 (by decide); omega)
    have bit0 : ∀ j, Host.matrix h (rows 0) (cols j) = H4 0 j := by
      intro j; rw [← hag _ _ hr0]; exact hc.2.2 0 j
    have bit1 : ∀ j, Host.matrix h (rows 1) (cols j) = H4 1 j := by
      intro j; rw [← hag _ _ hr1]; exact hc.2.2 1 j
    have bit2 : ∀ j, Host.matrix h (rows 2) (cols j) = H4 2 j := by
      intro j; rw [← hag _ _ hr2]; exact hc.2.2 2 j
    apply False.elim
    by_cases hc0 : Anchor (labelAt true h (cols 0))
    · have ht := anchor_rows_common_one_twins h (rows 1) (rows 2) (cols 0)
        hr1 hr2 hc0 (bit1 0) (bit2 0) (cols 3)
      rw [bit1 3,bit2 3] at ht
      contradiction
    · have hn0 : Nonanchor (labelAt true h (cols 0)) := by
        cases he : labelAt true h (cols 0) <;> simp_all [Anchor,Nonanchor]
      have hn1 := nonanchor_later true h (cols 0) (cols 1) (hc.2.1 0 1 (by decide)) hn0
      have hn2 := nonanchor_later true h (cols 0) (cols 2) (hc.2.1 0 2 (by decide)) hn0
      have h12 := anchor_row_connects h (rows 0) (cols 1) (cols 2) hr0 hn1 hn2 (bit0 1) (bit0 2)
      have h02 := anchor_row_connects h (rows 2) (cols 0) (cols 2) hr2 hn0 hn2 (bit2 0) (bit2 2)
      have h01 := sameClass_trans _ _ _ h02 (sameClass_symm _ _ h12)
      have ht := same_class_three_column_signatures h _ _ _ h01 h02 h12
      rcases anchor_exists _ hr0 with ⟨l0,k0,g0,a0,he0⟩
      rcases anchor_exists _ hr2 with ⟨l2,k2,g2,a2,he2⟩
      rcases ht with ht | ht | ht
      · have he := ht l0 k0 g0 a0
        have hm0 := bit0 0; have hm1 := bit0 1
        simp only [Host.matrix,he0] at hm0 hm1
        rw [hm0,hm1] at he
        contradiction
      · have he := ht l0 k0 g0 a0
        have hm0 := bit0 0; have hm2 := bit0 2
        simp only [Host.matrix,he0] at hm0 hm2
        rw [hm0,hm2] at he
        contradiction
      · have he := ht l2 k2 g2 a2
        have hm1 := bit2 1; have hm2 := bit2 2
        simp only [Host.matrix,he2] at hm1 hm2
        rw [hm1,hm2] at he
        contradiction
  · cases he : labelAt false h (rows 2) <;> simp_all [Anchor,Nonanchor]

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.TerminalAnchorRepair.no_new_copy
statement:
theorem no_new_copy (h : Nat) (rows cols : Fin 4 → Fin (size h))
    (hc : OrderedCopy H4 (matrix h) rows cols) : Copy h rows cols
proof:
:= by
  have hr2 := third_row_nonanchor_of_anchor_agreement h (matrix h)
    (anchor_agreement h) rows cols hc
  have hr3 := nonanchor_later false h (rows 2) (rows 3) (hc.1 2 3 (by decide)) hr2
  have hcols : ∀ j, ¬ TerminalColumn h (labelAt true h (cols j)) := by
    intro j hj
    have hz2 := terminal_nonanchor_zero h (rows 2) (cols j) hr2 hj
    have hz3 := terminal_nonanchor_zero h (rows 3) (cols j) hr3 hj
    have hb2 := hc.2.2 2 j
    have hb3 := hc.2.2 3 j
    rw [hz2] at hb2
    rw [hz3] at hb3
    have hjcases : j = 0 ∨ j = 1 ∨ j = 2 ∨ j = 3 := by omega
    rcases hjcases with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl <;> contradiction
  refine ⟨hc.1,hc.2.1,?_⟩
  intro i j
  rw [← outside_agreement h (rows i) (cols j) (hcols j)]
  exact hc.2.2 i j

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.TerminalAnchorRepair.original_first_column_terminal
statement:
theorem original_first_column_terminal (h : Nat) (hh : 1 ≤ h)
    (rows cols : Fin 4 → Fin (size h)) (hc : Copy h rows cols) :
    TerminalColumn h (labelAt true h (cols 0))
proof:
:= by
  rcases anchor_exists _ (second_row_anchor h rows cols hc) with ⟨l,k,g,a,hr1⟩
  rcases anchor_exists _ (first_column_anchor h rows cols hc) with ⟨u,v,w,b,hc0⟩
  rcases second_row_first_column_groups h rows cols hc l k g a u v w b hr1 hc0 with
    ⟨rfl,rfl,rfl,rfl⟩
  rcases all_copy_localization h hh rows cols hc with ⟨p,z,hr2,hc3⟩
  have hlh := anchor_index_level_bound false h (rows 1) l k 1 a hr1
  have hk := (anchor_index_valid false h (rows 1) l k 1 a hr1).2.1
  have hone : entry h (.variable h true p 0) (.anchor l k 0 b) = true := by
    have he : Host.matrix h (rows 2) (cols 0) = true := hc.2.2 2 0
    simpa only [Host.matrix,hr2,hc0] using he
  have hlast : entry h (.anchor l k 1 a) (.variable (h-1) false (p/2) z) = true := by
    have he : Host.matrix h (rows 1) (cols 3) = true := hc.2.2 1 3
    simpa only [Host.matrix,hr1,hc3] using he
  have hm : l = h ∧ (k = 4 ∨ k = 5) := by
    have hks : k=0 ∨ k=1 ∨ k=2 ∨ k=3 ∨ k=4 ∨ k=5 := by omega
    rcases hks with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl <;>
      simp [entry,rowRole,columnRole,signed] at hone hlast <;> omega
  simp [hc0,TerminalColumn,hm.1,hm.2]

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.TerminalAnchorRepair.free
statement: theorem free (h : Nat) (hh : 1 ≤ h) : HFree H4 (matrix h)
proof:
:= by
  intro rows cols hc
  have old := no_new_copy h rows cols hc
  have ht := original_first_column_terminal h hh rows cols old
  have hr := third_row_nonanchor h rows cols old
  have hz := terminal_nonanchor_zero h (rows 2) (cols 0) hr ht
  have hb := hc.2.2 2 0
  rw [hz] at hb
  contradiction

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.anchor_tag_mem
statement:
theorem anchor_tag_mem (column : Bool) (h l k g a : Nat)
    (hl : 1 ≤ l) (hlh : l ≤ h) (hk : k < 6) (hg : g < 2) (ha : a < 2 ^ h) :
    .anchor l k g a ∈ axis column h
proof:
:= by
  have hm : 0 < 2 ^ h := Nat.pow_pos (by decide)
  let rank := anchorRank (l-1) k g
  have hrank : rank + 1 ≤ 12*h := by unfold rank anchorRank; omega
  have hi : rank * 2^h + a < 12*h*2^h := by
    have hb := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (2^h) hrank
    rw [Nat.add_mul] at hb
    omega
  have hdiv : (rank*2^h+a)/2^h = rank := by
    rw [Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_mul_div_right _ _ hm, Nat.div_eq_of_lt ha]
    simp
  have hmod : (rank*2^h+a)%2^h = a := by
    rw [Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_mul_mod_self_right, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt ha]
  have he : anchorLabel h (rank*2^h+a) = .anchor l k g a := by
    unfold anchorLabel
    rw [hdiv,hmod]
    unfold rank anchorRank
    have hs : l-1+1=l := by omega
    have hl' : (2*(6*(l-1)+k)+g)/12+1 = l := by omega
    have hk' : (2*(6*(l-1)+k)+g)%12/2 = k := by omega
    have hg' : (2*(6*(l-1)+k)+g)%12%2 = g := by omega
    dsimp only
    rw [hl',hk',hg']

  apply List.mem_append.mpr
  apply Or.inl
  exact List.mem_map.mpr ⟨rank*2^h+a,List.mem_range.mpr hi,he⟩

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.dummy_tag_mem
statement:
theorem dummy_tag_mem (column : Bool) (h a : Nat) (ha : a < 2 ^ h) :
    .dummy a ∈ axis column h
proof:
:= by
  have hm : .dummy a ∈ dummies h := List.mem_map.mpr ⟨a,List.mem_range.mpr ha,rfl⟩
  apply List.mem_append.mpr
  apply Or.inr
  cases column
  · exact List.mem_append.mpr (Or.inr hm)
  · exact List.mem_append.mpr (Or.inl hm)

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.shiftNode_bound
statement:
theorem shiftNode_bound (h : Nat) (u v : Fin (2 ^ h)) (i : Nat) (hi : i ≤ h) :
    shiftNode h u v i < 2 ^ i
proof:
:= by
  unfold shiftNode
  rw [ancestor_eq_div_pow]
  apply (Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul (Nat.pow_pos (by decide : 0 < 2))).mpr
  rw [← dyadic_split h i hi]
  exact Nat.mod_lt _ (Nat.pow_pos (by decide))

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.shiftNode_root
statement: theorem shiftNode_root (h : Nat) (u v : Fin (2 ^ h)) : shiftNode h u v 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold shiftNode
  rw [ancestor_eq_div_pow]
  exact Nat.div_eq_of_lt (Nat.mod_lt _ (Nat.pow_pos (by decide)))

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.shiftNode_parent
statement:
theorem shiftNode_parent (h : Nat) (u v : Fin (2 ^ h)) (i : Nat) (hi : i < h) :
    shiftNode h u v (i+1) / 2 = shiftNode h u v i
proof:
:= by
  unfold shiftNode
  have he : h-i = (h-(i+1))+1 := by omega
  rw [he,ancestor]

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.shifted_variable_mem
statement:
theorem shifted_variable_mem (column : Bool) (h : Nat) (u v : Fin (2 ^ h))
    (i : Nat) (hi : i ≤ h) (sig : Bool) (seed : Fin (2 ^ h)) :
    .variable i (viewSign h i sig) (shiftNode h u v i) (seed.val%2^(h-i)) ∈ axis column h
proof:
:= by
  rw [variable_axis_mem_iff]
  exact ⟨hi,shiftNode_bound h u v i hi,Nat.mod_lt _ (Nat.pow_pos (by decide)),
    by intro he; simp [he,viewSign]⟩

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.size_pos
statement: private theorem size_pos (h : Nat) : 0 < size h
proof:
:=
  Nat.mul_pos (by omega) (Nat.pow_pos (by decide))

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.pick_label
statement:
theorem pick_label (column : Bool) (h : Nat) (p : Position) (hp : p ∈ axis column h) :
    labelAt column h (pick column h p) = p
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold pick
  rw [dif_pos hp]
  exact Classical.choose_spec (labelAt_surjective column h p hp)

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.shift_selected_info
statement:
theorem shift_selected_info (h : Nat) (u v : Fin (2^h)) (column : Bool) (x : Fin (size h))
    (hx : (shiftPath h u v).Selected column x) : SeedInfo h u v column (labelAt column h x)
proof:
:= by
  cases column
  · rcases hx with ⟨i,hi,sig,rfl⟩ | ⟨l,hl,hlh,k,hk,g,hg,rfl⟩ | rfl
    · try simp only [Bool.false_eq_true,↓reduceIte]
      rw [(shiftPath h u v).rowLabel i hi sig]
      exact ⟨hi,rfl,rfl⟩
    · try simp only [Bool.false_eq_true,↓reduceIte]
      rw [(shiftPath h u v).raLabel l hl hlh k hk g hg]
      rfl
    · try simp only [Bool.false_eq_true,↓reduceIte]
      rw [(shiftPath h u v).rdLabel]
      rfl
  · rcases hx with ⟨i,hi,sig,rfl⟩ | ⟨l,hl,hlh,k,hk,g,hg,rfl⟩ | rfl
    · try simp only [Bool.false_eq_true,↓reduceIte]
      rw [(shiftPath h u v).colLabel i hi sig]
      exact ⟨hi,rfl,rfl⟩
    · try simp only [Bool.false_eq_true,↓reduceIte]
      rw [(shiftPath h u v).caLabel l hl hlh k hk g hg]
      rfl
    · try simp only [Bool.false_eq_true,↓reduceIte]
      rw [(shiftPath h u v).cdLabel]
      rfl

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.seed_info_fixed_row
statement:
private theorem seed_info_fixed_row (h : Nat) (u v w : Fin (2^h)) (c : Position)
    (hv : SeedInfo h u v true c) (hw : SeedInfo h u w true c) : v = w
proof:
:= by
  cases c with
  | anchor l k g a => exact Fin.ext (hv.symm.trans hw)
  | dummy a => exact Fin.ext (hv.symm.trans hw)
  | «variable» i sig q a =>
    rcases hv with ⟨hi,hqv,hav⟩
    rcases hw with ⟨_,hqw,haw⟩
    apply Fin.ext
    apply shift_class_injective (2^h) (2^(h-i)) u.val v.val w.val
      (dyadic_block_divides h i hi) u.isLt v.isLt w.isLt
    · simpa [shiftNode,ancestor_eq_div_pow,shiftLeaf] using hqv.symm.trans hqw
    · exact hav.symm.trans haw

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.seed_info_fixed_column
statement:
private theorem seed_info_fixed_column (h : Nat) (v u w : Fin (2^h)) (r : Position)
    (hu : SeedInfo h u v false r) (hw : SeedInfo h w v false r) : u = w
proof:
:= by
  cases r with
  | anchor l k g a => exact Fin.ext (hu.symm.trans hw)
  | dummy a => exact Fin.ext (hu.symm.trans hw)
  | «variable» i sig q a =>
    rcases hu with ⟨hi,hqu,hau⟩
    rcases hw with ⟨_,hqw,haw⟩
    apply Fin.ext
    apply shift_class_injective (2^h) (2^(h-i)) v.val u.val w.val
      (dyadic_block_divides h i hi) v.isLt u.isLt w.isLt
    · simpa [shiftNode,ancestor_eq_div_pow,shiftLeaf,Nat.add_comm] using hqu.symm.trans hqw
    · exact hau.symm.trans haw

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.protected_seed_separation
statement:
theorem protected_seed_separation (h : Nat) (u v u' v' : Fin (2^h)) (r c : Position)
    (hr : SeedInfo h u v false r) (hr' : SeedInfo h u' v' false r)
    (hc : SeedInfo h u v true c) (hc' : SeedInfo h u' v' true c)
    (hp : Anchor r ∨ Anchor c ∨ Dummy r ∨ Dummy c ∨ (Root r ∧ Root c)) :
    u = u' ∧ v = v'
proof:
:= by
  cases r with
  | anchor l k g a =>
    have he : u = u' := Fin.ext (hr.symm.trans hr')
    subst u'
    exact ⟨rfl,seed_info_fixed_row h u v v' c hc hc'⟩
  | dummy a =>
    have he : u = u' := Fin.ext (hr.symm.trans hr')
    subst u'
    exact ⟨rfl,seed_info_fixed_row h u v v' c hc hc'⟩
  | «variable» i sig q a =>
    cases c with
    | anchor l k g b =>
      have he : v = v' := Fin.ext (hc.symm.trans hc')
      subst v'
      exact ⟨seed_info_fixed_column h v u u' _ hr hr',rfl⟩
    | dummy b =>
      have he : v = v' := Fin.ext (hc.symm.trans hc')
      subst v'
      exact ⟨seed_info_fixed_column h v u u' _ hr hr',rfl⟩
    | «variable» j tau p b =>
      have hij : i = 0 ∧ j = 0 := by simpa [Anchor,Dummy,Root] using hp
      rcases hij with ⟨rfl,rfl⟩
      simp only [SeedInfo,Nat.sub_zero,Bool.false_eq_true,↓reduceIte,Nat.mod_eq_of_lt u.isLt,Nat.mod_eq_of_lt u'.isLt] at hr hr'
      simp only [SeedInfo,Nat.sub_zero,Bool.false_eq_true,↓reduceIte,Nat.mod_eq_of_lt v.isLt,Nat.mod_eq_of_lt v'.isLt] at hc hc'
      exact ⟨Fin.ext (hr.2.2.symm.trans hr'.2.2),Fin.ext (hc.2.2.symm.trans hc'.2.2)⟩

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.shiftPath_separates
statement:
theorem shiftPath_separates (h : Nat) (a b : Fin (2^h) × Fin (2^h)) (r c : Fin (size h))
    (hr : (shiftPath h a.1 a.2).Selected false r)
    (hc : (shiftPath h a.1 a.2).Selected true c)
    (hr' : (shiftPath h b.1 b.2).Selected false r)
    (hc' : (shiftPath h b.1 b.2).Selected true c) (hp : Protected h r c) : a = b
proof:
:= by
  have he := protected_seed_separation h a.1 a.2 b.1 b.2 (labelAt false h r) (labelAt true h c)
    (shift_selected_info h a.1 a.2 false r hr) (shift_selected_info h b.1 b.2 false r hr')
    (shift_selected_info h a.1 a.2 true c hc) (shift_selected_info h b.1 b.2 true c hc') hp
  exact Prod.ext he.1 he.2

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.arbitrary_edit_distance
statement:
theorem arbitrary_edit_distance (h : Nat) (hh : 1 ≤ h) (B : BinaryMatrix (size h))
    (hf : HFree H4 B) : (2^h)^2 ≤ editCount h B
proof:
:= by
  have hb := edit_count_of_separating_paths h hh B hf
    (cartesian (List.finRange (2^h)) (List.finRange (2^h)))
    (cartesian_nodup _ _ (List.nodup_finRange _) (List.nodup_finRange _))
    (fun a => shiftPath h a.1 a.2)
    (fun a _ b _ r c hr hc hr' hc' hp => shiftPath_separates h a b r c hr hc hr' hc' hp)
  simpa [cartesian_length,Nat.pow_succ] using hb

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Counting.mem_copies
statement:
theorem mem_copies {n : Nat} (A : BinaryMatrix n) (e : Embedding n) :
    e ∈ copies A ↔ OrderedCopy H4 A e.1 e.2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rcases e with ⟨rows,cols⟩
  simp [copies,mem_cartesian,mem_assignments]

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Counting.copies_nodup
statement: theorem copies_nodup {n : Nat} (A : BinaryMatrix n) : (copies A).Nodup
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact List.Pairwise.filter _ (cartesian_nodup _ _ (assignments_nodup _ _) (assignments_nodup _ _))

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Counting.rebuild_remainder
statement:
theorem rebuild_remainder (n : Nat) (e : Embedding n) :
    rebuild n (e.1 2,e.2 3) (remainder n e) = e
proof:
:= by
  apply Prod.ext <;> funext i
  all_goals have hi : i = 0 ∨ i = 1 ∨ i = 2 ∨ i = 3 := by omega
  all_goals rcases hi with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl <;> simp [rebuild,remainder]

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Counting.candidates_length
statement:
theorem candidates_length (n : Nat) (cells : List (Fin n × Fin n)) :
    (candidates n cells).length = cells.length * n ^ 6
proof:
:= by
  simp [candidates,List.length_flatMap,assignments_length,List.map_const',List.sum_replicate_nat]

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Counting.bound_from_localization
statement:
theorem bound_from_localization {n : Nat} (A : BinaryMatrix n) (cells : List (Fin n × Fin n))
    (hz : ∀ rows cols, OrderedCopy H4 A rows cols → (rows 2,cols 3) ∈ cells) :
    copyCount A ≤ cells.length * n ^ 6
proof:
:= by
  have hs : copies A ⊆ candidates n cells := by
    intro e he
    have hc := (mem_copies A e).mp he
    exact List.mem_flatMap.mpr ⟨(e.1 2,e.2 3),hz e.1 e.2 hc,
      List.mem_map.mpr ⟨remainder n e,mem_assignments _ _ _,rebuild_remainder n e⟩⟩
  simpa only [copyCount,candidates_length] using (copies_nodup A).length_le_of_subset hs

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.minus_nonterminal_incidence_iff
statement:
theorem minus_nonterminal_incidence_iff (h i l k g q a z : Nat) (hi : i < h) :
    entry h (.anchor l k g a) (.variable i false q z) = true ↔
      (((k = 4 ∨ k = 5) ∧ g = 0 ∧ l = i ∧ q % 2 = k - 4) ∨
       (l = i + 1 ∧ g = 1 ∧ (k = 1 ∨ k = 4 ∨ k = 5)))
proof:
:= by
  simp [entry, columnRole, signed, Nat.ne_of_lt hi]
  omega

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.earlier_minus_incidence_even
statement:
theorem earlier_minus_incidence_even (h i l k g q a z : Nat)
    (hi : i < h) (hpos : 1 ≤ i) (hl : 1 ≤ l)
    (horder : anchorRank (l - 1) k g < anchorRank (i - 1) 4 1)
    (hentry : entry h (.anchor l k g a) (.variable i false q z) = true) :
    q % 2 = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [minus_nonterminal_incidence_iff h i l k g q a z hi] at hentry
  unfold anchorRank at horder
  omega

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.nonterminal_sibling_exception_impossible
statement:
theorem nonterminal_sibling_exception_impossible (h i l k g p q b a z : Nat)
    (hi : i < h) (hpos : 1 ≤ i) (hl : 1 ≤ l)
    (horder : anchorRank (l - 1) k g < anchorRank (i - 1) 4 1)
    (hentry : entry h (.anchor l k g a) (.variable i false q z) = true)
    (hpq : p < q) (hqb : q / 2 ≤ b) (hbp : b ≤ p / 2) : False
proof:
:= by
  have heven := earlier_minus_incidence_even h i l k g q a z hi hpos hl horder hentry
  have hs := OrderedMatrixRemoval4.nonterminal_siblings p q b hpq hqb hbp
  omega

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.earlier_minus_role_even
statement:
theorem earlier_minus_role_even (h i l k g q z : Nat)
    (hi : i < h) (hpos : 1 ≤ i) (hl : 1 ≤ l)
    (horder : anchorRank (l - 1) k g < anchorRank (i - 1) 4 1)
    (hrole : columnRole h l k g (.variable i false q z)) : q % 2 = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [columnRole, signed, Nat.ne_of_lt hi] at hrole
  unfold anchorRank at horder
  omega

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.ancestor_eq_div_pow
statement: theorem ancestor_eq_div_pow (d p : Nat) : ancestor d p = p / 2 ^ d
proof:
:= by
  induction d with
  | zero => simp [ancestor]
  | succ d ih => rw [ancestor, ih, Nat.div_div_eq_div_mul, Nat.pow_succ]

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.tree_variable_mem_iff
statement:
theorem tree_variable_mem_iff (column : Bool) (rem depth node j : Nat)
    (s : Bool) (q a : Nat) :
    .variable j s q a ∈ tree column rem depth node ↔
      depth ≤ j ∧ j ≤ depth + rem ∧ ancestor (j - depth) q = node ∧
      a < 2 ^ (depth + rem - j) ∧ (j = depth + rem → s = true)
proof:
:= by
  induction rem generalizing depth node with
  | zero =>
    constructor
    · intro hm
      have he := List.eq_of_mem_singleton hm
      cases he
      simp [ancestor]
    · rintro ⟨hd,hj,hn,ha,hs⟩
      have he : j = depth := by omega
      subst j
      simp [ancestor] at hn
      have hsa := hs (by omega)
      have haa : a = 0 := by simpa using ha
      subst q
      subst s
      subst a
      simp [tree]
  | succ rem ih =>
    by_cases hd : depth ≤ j
    · by_cases hj : j = depth
      · subst j
        cases column <;> cases s <;>
          simp [tree, block, ancestor, ih] <;> omega
      · have he : j - depth = (j - (depth + 1)) + 1 := by omega
        have ht : depth + (rem + 1) = depth + 1 + rem := by omega
        have hanc : ancestor (j - depth) q = ancestor (j - (depth + 1)) q / 2 := by
          rw [he, ancestor]
        simp only [tree, List.mem_append, block, List.mem_map, List.mem_range,
          Position.variable.injEq, ih]
        constructor
        · intro hm
          rcases hm with ((hm | hm) | hm) | hm
          · rcases hm with ⟨a',ha',hd,_,_,_⟩; exact False.elim (hj hd.symm)
          · rcases hm with ⟨hd,hj',hn,ha,hs⟩
            refine ⟨by omega, by omega, ?_, by simpa only [ht] using ha, ?_⟩
            · rw [hanc, hn]; omega
            · intro hj'; exact hs (by omega)
          · rcases hm with ⟨hd,hj',hn,ha,hs⟩
            refine ⟨by omega, by omega, ?_, by simpa only [ht] using ha, ?_⟩
            · rw [hanc, hn]; omega
            · intro hj'; exact hs (by omega)
          · rcases hm with ⟨a',ha',hd,_,_,_⟩; exact False.elim (hj hd.symm)
        · rintro ⟨hd,hj',hn,ha,hs⟩
          have hd' : depth + 1 ≤ j := by omega
          rw [hanc] at hn
          have hb : ancestor (j - (depth + 1)) q = 2 * node ∨
              ancestor (j - (depth + 1)) q = 2 * node + 1 := by omega
          rcases hb with hb | hb
          · exact Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨hd',by omega,hb,by simpa only [ht] using ha,
              fun ht' => hs (by omega)⟩))
          · exact Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨hd',by omega,hb,by simpa only [ht] using ha,
              fun ht' => hs (by omega)⟩)
    · constructor
      · intro hm
        exact False.elim (hd (tree_location column (rem + 1) depth node j s q a hm).1)
      · intro hm; exact False.elim (hd hm.1)

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.variable_axis_mem_iff
statement:
theorem variable_axis_mem_iff (column : Bool) (h j : Nat) (s : Bool) (q a : Nat) :
    .variable j s q a ∈ axis column h ↔
      j ≤ h ∧ q < 2 ^ j ∧ a < 2 ^ (h - j) ∧ (j = h → s = true)
proof:
:= by
  have ht : .variable j s q a ∈ tree column h 0 0 ↔
      j ≤ h ∧ q < 2 ^ j ∧ a < 2 ^ (h - j) ∧ (j = h → s = true) := by
    rw [tree_variable_mem_iff]
    simp [ancestor_eq_div_pow, Nat.div_eq_zero_iff_lt (Nat.pow_pos (by decide : 0 < 2))]
  unfold axis nonanchors
  cases column <;> simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, List.mem_append]
  all_goals simp [anchors, anchorLabel, dummies, ht]

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.tree_depth_sign
statement:
theorem tree_depth_sign (column : Bool) (rem depth node j : Nat) (s : Bool) (q a : Nat)
    (hm : .variable j s q a ∈ tree column rem depth node) :
    j ≤ depth + rem ∧ (j = depth + rem → s = true)
proof:
:= by
  induction rem generalizing depth node with
  | zero =>
    have he := List.eq_of_mem_singleton hm
    cases he
    simp
  | succ rem ih =>
    simp only [tree, List.mem_append] at hm
    rcases hm with ((hm | hm) | hm) | hm
    · simp only [block, List.mem_map] at hm
      rcases hm with ⟨a, _, he⟩
      cases he
      constructor
      · omega
      · intro hbad; exact False.elim (by omega)
    · have ht := ih _ _ hm; constructor
      · omega
      · intro he; exact ht.2 (by omega)
    · have ht := ih _ _ hm; constructor
      · omega
      · intro he; exact ht.2 (by omega)
    · simp only [block, List.mem_map] at hm
      rcases hm with ⟨a, _, he⟩
      cases he
      constructor
      · omega
      · intro hbad; exact False.elim (by omega)

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.variable_tag_valid
statement:
theorem variable_tag_valid (column : Bool) (h j : Nat) (s : Bool) (q a : Nat)
    (hm : .variable j s q a ∈ axis column h) : j ≤ h ∧ (j = h → s = true)
proof:
:= by
  rcases List.mem_append.mp hm with hm | hm
  · simp only [anchors, List.mem_map] at hm
    rcases hm with ⟨index, _, he⟩
    unfold anchorLabel at he
    contradiction
  · unfold nonanchors at hm
    cases column <;> simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, List.mem_append] at hm
    · rcases hm with ht | hd
      · simpa using tree_depth_sign false h 0 0 j s q a ht
      · simp only [dummies, List.mem_map] at hd
        rcases hd with ⟨_, _, he⟩; contradiction
    · rcases hm with hd | ht
      · simp only [dummies, List.mem_map] at hd
        rcases hd with ⟨_, _, he⟩; contradiction
      · simpa using tree_depth_sign true h 0 0 j s q a ht

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.class_triangle_terminal
statement:
theorem class_triangle_terminal (h d e f : Nat) (s t u : Bool)
    (hde : d ≠ e ∨ s ≠ t) (hef : e ≠ f ∨ t ≠ u) (hdf : d ≠ f ∨ s ≠ u)
    (hd : d ≤ h) (he : e ≤ h) (hf : f ≤ h)
    (hs : d = h → s = true) (ht : e = h → t = true) (hu : f = h → u = true)
    (h01 : ClassEdge h d e s t) (h12 : ClassEdge h e f t u)
    (h02 : ClassEdge h d f s u) :
    (d = h ∨ d + 1 = h) ∧ (e = h ∨ e + 1 = h) ∧ (f = h ∨ f + 1 = h)
proof:
:= by
  cases s <;> cases t <;> cases u <;> simp_all [ClassEdge] <;> omega

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.entry_support
statement:
theorem entry_support (h i j p q a b : Nat) (s t : Bool)
    (_hr : i ≤ h) (_hc : j ≤ h) (hs : i = h → s = true) (ht : j = h → t = true)
    (he : entry h (.variable i s p a) (.variable j t q b) = true) :
    Supports h i j s t
proof:
:= by
  cases s <;> cases t <;> simp_all [entry, signed, Supports] <;> omega

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.support_pair_edge
statement:
theorem support_pair_edge (h i d e : Nat) (r s t : Bool)
    (hi : i ≤ h) (hd : d ≤ h) (he : e ≤ h)
    (hs : d = h → s = true) (ht : e = h → t = true)
    (hdiff : d ≠ e ∨ s ≠ t)
    (h0 : Supports h i d r s) (h1 : Supports h i e r t) : ClassEdge h d e s t
proof:
:= by
  cases r <;> cases s <;> cases t <;> simp_all [Supports, ClassEdge] <;> omega

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.terminal_pair_forces_leaf
statement:
theorem terminal_pair_forces_leaf (h i d e : Nat) (r s t : Bool)
    (hi : i ≤ h) (hd : d = h ∨ d + 1 = h) (he : e = h ∨ e + 1 = h)
    (hdiff : d ≠ e ∨ s ≠ t)
    (h0 : Supports h i d r s) (h1 : Supports h i e r t) : i = h
proof:
:= by
  cases r <;> cases s <;> cases t <;> simp_all [Supports] <;> omega

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.crown_columns_distinct_classes
statement:
theorem crown_columns_distinct_classes (h : Nat) (rows : Fin 3 → Position)
    (cd cn ca : Fin 3 → Nat) (cs : Fin 3 → Bool)
    (hr : ∀ i, Nonanchor (rows i))
    (hm : ∀ i j, entry h (rows i) (.variable (cd j) (cs j) (cn j) (ca j)) = decide (i ≠ j)) :
    ∀ i j, i ≠ j → cd i ≠ cd j ∨ cs i ≠ cs j
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hij
  by_cases hd : cd i = cd j
  · by_cases hs : cs i = cs j
    · have hji : j ≠ i := fun he => hij he.symm
      rcases Nat.le_total (cn i) (cn j) with hle | hle
      · have he : entry h (rows j) (.variable (cd j) (cs j) (cn i) (ca i)) = true := by
          simpa only [hd, hs] using (hm j i).trans (decide_eq_true_iff.mpr hji)
        have ht := variable_column_nested h (cd j) (cs j) (cn i) (cn j) (ca i) (ca j)
          hle (rows j) (hr j) he
        rw [hm j j] at ht
        simp at ht
      · have he : entry h (rows i) (.variable (cd i) (cs i) (cn j) (ca j)) = true := by
          simpa only [← hd, ← hs] using (hm i j).trans (decide_eq_true_iff.mpr hij)
        have ht := variable_column_nested h (cd i) (cs i) (cn j) (cn i) (ca j) (ca i)
          hle (rows i) (hr i) he
        rw [hm i i] at ht
        simp at ht
    · exact Or.inr hs
  · exact Or.inl hd

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.no_variable_crown
statement:
theorem no_variable_crown (h : Nat) (rd rn ra cd cn ca : Fin 3 → Nat)
    (rs cs : Fin 3 → Bool)
    (hr : ∀ i, rd i ≤ h ∧ (rd i = h → rs i = true))
    (hc : ∀ i, cd i ≤ h ∧ (cd i = h → cs i = true))
    (hm : ∀ i j, entry h (.variable (rd i) (rs i) (rn i) (ra i))
      (.variable (cd j) (cs j) (cn j) (ca j)) = decide (i ≠ j)) : False
proof:
:= by
  have hd := crown_columns_distinct_classes h
    (fun i => .variable (rd i) (rs i) (rn i) (ra i)) cd cn ca cs (fun _ => trivial) hm
  have hd01 := hd 0 1 (by decide)
  have hd12 := hd 1 2 (by decide)
  have hd02 := hd 0 2 (by decide)
  have support : ∀ i j : Fin 3, i ≠ j → Supports h (rd i) (cd j) (rs i) (cs j) := by
    intro i j hij
    apply entry_support h (rd i) (cd j) (rn i) (cn j) (ra i) (ca j) (rs i) (cs j)
      (hr i).1 (hc j).1 (hr i).2 (hc j).2
    exact (hm i j).trans (decide_eq_true_iff.mpr hij)
  have h01 := support_pair_edge h (rd 2) (cd 0) (cd 1) (rs 2) (cs 0) (cs 1)
    (hr 2).1 (hc 0).1 (hc 1).1 (hc 0).2 (hc 1).2 hd01
    (support 2 0 (by decide)) (support 2 1 (by decide))
  have h12 := support_pair_edge h (rd 0) (cd 1) (cd 2) (rs 0) (cs 1) (cs 2)
    (hr 0).1 (hc 1).1 (hc 2).1 (hc 1).2 (hc 2).2 hd12
    (support 0 1 (by decide)) (support 0 2 (by decide))
  have h02 := support_pair_edge h (rd 1) (cd 0) (cd 2) (rs 1) (cs 0) (cs 2)
    (hr 1).1 (hc 0).1 (hc 2).1 (hc 0).2 (hc 2).2 hd02
    (support 1 0 (by decide)) (support 1 2 (by decide))
  have ht := class_triangle_terminal h (cd 0) (cd 1) (cd 2) (cs 0) (cs 1) (cs 2)
    hd01 hd12 hd02 (hc 0).1 (hc 1).1 (hc 2).1 (hc 0).2 (hc 1).2 (hc 2).2 h01 h12 h02
  have hleaf0 := terminal_pair_forces_leaf h (rd 0) (cd 1) (cd 2) (rs 0) (cs 1) (cs 2)
    (hr 0).1 ht.2.1 ht.2.2 hd12 (support 0 1 (by decide)) (support 0 2 (by decide))
  have hleaf1 := terminal_pair_forces_leaf h (rd 1) (cd 0) (cd 2) (rs 1) (cs 0) (cs 2)
    (hr 1).1 ht.1 ht.2.2 hd02 (support 1 0 (by decide)) (support 1 2 (by decide))
  have hs0 := (hr 0).2 hleaf0
  have hs1 := (hr 1).2 hleaf1
  rcases Nat.le_total (rn 0) (rn 1) with hle | hle
  · have he := hm 1 0
    simp only [hleaf1, hs1] at he
    have hn := variable_row_nested h h true (rn 0) (rn 1) (ra 0) (ra 1) hle
      (.variable (cd 0) (cs 0) (cn 0) (ca 0)) (by trivial) he
    have hz := hm 0 0
    simp only [hleaf0, hs0] at hz
    rw [hz] at hn
    contradiction
  · have he := hm 0 1
    simp only [hleaf0, hs0] at he
    have hn := variable_row_nested h h true (rn 1) (rn 0) (ra 1) (ra 0) hle
      (.variable (cd 1) (cs 1) (cn 1) (ca 1)) (by trivial) he
    have hz := hm 1 1
    simp only [hleaf1, hs1] at hz
    rw [hz] at hn
    contradiction

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.variable_data_exists
statement:
theorem variable_data_exists (p : Position) (hp : IsVariable p) :
    ∃ v : VariableData, v.position = p
proof:
:= by
  cases p with
  | anchor => contradiction
  | dummy => contradiction
  | «variable» d s q a => exact ⟨⟨d, s, q, a⟩, rfl⟩

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.zero_nonanchors_variable
statement:
theorem zero_nonanchors_variable (h : Nat) (r c : Position)
    (hr : Nonanchor r) (hc : Nonanchor c) (he : entry h r c = false) :
    IsVariable r ∧ IsVariable c
proof:
:= by
  cases r <;> cases c <;> simp_all [Nonanchor, IsVariable, entry]

name: OrderedMatrixRemoval4.Host.nonanchor_crown_exclusion
statement:
theorem nonanchor_crown_exclusion (h : Nat) (rows cols : Fin 3 → Fin (size h))
    (hr : ∀ i, Nonanchor (labelAt false h (rows i)))
    (hc : ∀ i, Nonanchor (labelAt true h (cols i)))
    (hm : ∀ i j, matrix h (rows i) (cols j) = decide (i ≠ j)) : False
proof:
:= by
  have hv : ∀ i, IsVariable (labelAt false h (rows i)) ∧
      IsVariable (labelAt true h (cols i)) := by
    intro i
    apply zero_nonanchors_variable h _ _ (hr i) (hc i)
    simpa [matrix] using hm i i
  have hrd := fun i => variable_data_exists _ (hv i).1
  have hcd := fun i => variable_data_exists _ (hv i).2
  let rr := fun i => Classical.choose (hrd i)
  let cc := fun i => Classical.choose (hcd i)
  have her : ∀ i, (rr i).position = labelAt false h (rows i) :=
    fun i => Classical.choose_spec (hrd i)
  have hec : ∀ i, (cc i).position = labelAt true h (cols i) :=
    fun i => Classical.choose_spec (hcd i)
  apply no_variable_crown h (fun i => (rr i).depth) (fun i => (rr i).node)
    (fun i => (rr i).clone) (fun i => (cc i).depth) (fun i => (cc i).node)
    (fun i => (cc i).clone) (fun i => (rr i).plus) (fun i => (cc i).plus)
  · intro i
    apply variable_tag_valid false h
    rw [← VariableData.position, her i]
    exact List.getElem_mem _
  · intro i
    apply variable_tag_valid true h
    rw [← VariableData.position, hec i]
    exact List.getElem_mem _
  · intro i j
    change entry h (rr i).position (cc j).position = _
    rw [her i, hec j]
    exact hm i j
